Vela: Scaling Vision-Language-Action Models with Adaptive Action Curve Parametrization VLA

spline-based action representation continuous trajectories multi-embodiment VLA foundation model action curve parametrization

简要说明：Vela提出了一种基于自适应样条的动作表示方法，用于视觉-语言-动作模型，实现具有运动相关时间分辨率的连续轨迹预测，并在多实体数据和真实世界长期任务中进行了验证。

TLDR: Vela introduces an adaptive spline-based action representation for VLA models, enabling continuous trajectory prediction with motion-dependent temporal resolution, pretrained on multi-embodiment data and validated in simulation and real-world long-horizon tasks.

Abstract: Most vision-language-action models represent future motion as fixed-rate action chunks, tying temporal resolution and prediction horizon to a fixed output budget. This pointwise representation wastes capacity on highly correlated neighboring actions, leaves temporal continuity and smoothness to be learned implicitly, and forces a tradeoff between long-horizon coverage and the local precision required for contact-rich manipulation. To address these limitations, we introduce Vela, a vision-language-action foundation model that represents future robot behavior as continuous trajectories. Vela combines a compact spline-based action representation with motion-dependent temporal support and a shared action interface for heterogeneous embodiments, allowing a fixed output budget to adapt its temporal resolution across motions. We pretrain Vela on large-scale multi-embodiment robot data and evaluate it on LIBERO-X, EBench, and two real-world long-horizon tasks, egg-cake cooking and potato shredding, obtaining promising results across simulation and physical manipulation. These results highlight the potential of continuous action representations as a foundation for future embodied foundation models. Project page and more results: https://clementine24.github.io/Vela/ .

摘要（中文）：大多数视觉-语言-动作模型将未来运动表示为固定速率的动作块，从而将时间分辨率和预测范围限制在固定的输出预算内。这种逐点表示方式在高度相关的相邻动作上浪费了容量，使得时间连续性和平滑性只能隐式学习，并且迫使模型在长时程覆盖范围与接触密集型操作所需的局部精度之间做出权衡。为解决这些局限性，我们提出了Vela，一种将未来机器人行为表示为连续轨迹的视觉-语言-动作基础模型。Vela结合了基于样条的紧凑动作表示、随运动变化的时间支撑以及面向异构本体的共享动作接口，使固定输出预算能够跨不同运动自适应调整其时间分辨率。我们在大规模多本体机器人数据上预训练了Vela，并在LIBERO-X、EBench以及两项真实世界长时程任务——蛋饼烹饪和土豆切丝——上进行了评估，在仿真和物理操作中均取得了令人满意的结果。这些结果凸显了连续动作表示作为未来具身基础模型基础的潜力。项目页面及更多结果：https://clementine24.github.io/Vela/。

Authors: Yifan Li, Jiaxu Wang, Dongming Wu, Yicheng Jiang, Ryan Ji, Xiangyu Yue, Yanwei Fu

EvoMem-VLA: State-Evolution Memory for Long-Horizon Robot Manipulation VLA

state-evolution memory delta tokenization long-horizon manipulation vision-language-action multi-stage tasks

简要说明：EvoMem-VLA 通过条件增量标记化编码历史状态之间的变化，构建状态演化记忆，提升 VLA 模型在长时程机器人操作任务中的表现。

TLDR: EvoMem-VLA introduces state-evolution memory using conditional delta tokenization to encode changes between historical frames, improving long-horizon robot manipulation for VLA models across simulation and real-world benchmarks.

Abstract: Most vision-language-action (VLA) models rely on current observations and lose task-relevant evidence once it leaves view, limiting performance on long-horizon, memory-dependent tasks. Existing efforts incorporate compressed historical features or sparse visual keyframes. However, isolated snapshots can leave the policy uncertain about what changed during past interactions and which action should follow. To overcome this limitation, we propose EvoMem-VLA, which constructs state-evolution memory by explicitly encoding and retaining observed changes between historical states. These change representations preserve evidence of interaction outcomes, allowing the policy to track task progress beyond isolated snapshots. Specifically, we introduce conditional delta tokenization to encode ordered frame pairs into directional, source-conditioned delta tokens, each associated with its corresponding state evidence. A shared VLM backbone supports task-adaptive routing: normal long-horizon tasks follow a direct action route, whereas multi-stage tasks use a subtask route that generates an executable subtask as an additional input for action generation. With a single jointly trained policy for each simulation benchmark, EvoMem-VLA achieves success rates of 80.7\% on RMBench, 82.0\% on RoboMME and 83.8\% across four real-world tasks spanning two robot embodiments. These results represent substantial improvements over the previous state of the art in all three evaluation settings.

摘要（中文）：大多数视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型依赖当前观测，一旦任务相关证据离开视野便丢失，从而限制了其在长时程、依赖记忆的任务上的表现。现有方法尝试融入压缩的历史特征或稀疏的视觉关键帧，然而，孤立的快照可能使策略在过往交互中发生了什么变化、以及接下来应执行何种动作方面产生不确定性。为克服这一局限，我们提出EvoMem-VLA，通过显式编码并保留历史状态之间观测到的变化，构建状态演化记忆。这些变化表征保留了交互结果的证据，使策略能够超越孤立快照，追踪任务进展。具体而言，我们引入了条件增量分词方法，将有序帧对编码为方向性、以源状态为条件的增量令牌，每个令牌对应相关联的状态证据。共享的视觉-语言模型（VLM）主干支持任务自适应路由：常规长时程任务沿直接动作路线执行，而多阶段任务则采用子任务路线，生成一个可执行的子任务作为动作生成的额外输入。凭借每个仿真基准上单一联合训练的策略，EvoMem-VLA在RMBench上达到80.7\%的成功率，在RoboMME上达到82.0\%，并在涵盖两种机器人本体的四项真实世界任务中达到83.8\%的成功率。在全部三种评估设置中，这些结果相较先前最先进方法均有显著提升。

Authors: Yuheng Na, Zhide Zhong, Junjie He, Junfeng Li, Haodong Yan, Jiaan Wang, Jiaguan Zhu, Yangyang Zheng, Tianyu Huang, Haoang Li

RMMBench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Robotic Mobile Manipulation Manipulation

mobile manipulation benchmark vision-language models navigation-manipulation long-horizon tasks spatial perception

简要说明：RMMBench 是一个评估视觉语言模型在机器人移动操作任务中的基准，整合导航和操作到 70 个典型场景中，以评估空间感知和长时程任务执行能力。

TLDR: RMMBench is a benchmark for evaluating vision-language models on robotic mobile manipulation tasks, integrating navigation and manipulation into 70 canonical scenarios to assess spatial perception and long-horizon task execution.

Abstract: Although the advancement of vision-language models (VLMs) has endowed robots with enhanced environmental understanding and task reasoning, a comprehensive evaluation methodology is important to advance the integration of VLMs in robotic navigation and manipulation. However, current benchmarks lack a comprehensive method to evaluate diverse robotic tasks, and evaluation metrics remain relatively constrained, making it difficult to assess the embodied capabilities of VLMs in a thorough and fine-grained manner. To address this issue, we propose RMMBench, an evaluation benchmark that requires robots to understand language instructions and perform long-horizon tasks in continuous spaces. RMMBench seamlessly integrates high- and low-level embodied tasks into a unified framework, constructing a "navigation-manipulation" task suite comprising 70 canonical task scenarios that range from localized manipulation to long-horizon composite navigation. The results reveal that leading VLMs still face major challenges in spatial localization when performing mobile manipulation tasks, and also highlight the necessity of enhancing the spatial perception capability of robots during long-horizon interactions. RMMBench can be accessed at https://mxxq-stack.github.io/rmmbench-project/

摘要（中文）：尽管视觉-语言模型（VLMs）的进步赋予了机器人更强的环境理解与任务推理能力，但建立一套全面的评估方法对于推动VLM在机器人导航与操作中的集成至关重要。然而，现有基准缺乏对多样化机器人任务进行综合评估的手段，且评估指标相对有限，难以全面、细粒度地衡量VLM在具身智能方面的能力。为解决这一问题，我们提出了RMMBench，一个要求机器人理解语言指令并在连续空间中执行长时程任务的评估基准。RMMBench将高层级与低层级的具身任务无缝整合到一个统一框架中，构建了一个包含70个典型任务场景的“导航-操作”任务套件，覆盖从局部操作到长时程复合导航的各类任务。实验结果表明，当前领先的VLM在执行移动操作任务时仍面临空间定位的重大挑战，同时也凸显了在长时程交互过程中增强机器人空间感知能力的必要性。RMMBench可通过 https://mxxq-stack.github.io/rmmbench-project/ 访问。

Authors: Huapeng Li, Fuxiang Feng, Jinqiu Fan, Shuo Yang, Fengjiao Chen, Xuezhi Cao, Ran Song, Wei Zhang

TUCO: Curating Simulation Demonstrations for Sim-to-Real Robot Policy Co-Training RLRobot

data curation sim-to-real co-training influence functions robot policy

简要说明：TUCO首次系统研究了仿真到现实机器人策略协同训练中的数据筛选问题，利用影响函数将演示效应分解为轨迹级效用和集合级覆盖率，通过统一的筛选目标选择互补演示，在多个仿真及真实环境设置中达到最先进性能。

TLDR: TUCO is the first systematic study of data curation for sim-to-real robot policy co-training, using influence functions to decompose demonstration effects into trajectory-level utility and set-level coverage, enabling a unified curation objective that selects complementary demonstrations and achieves state-of-the-art performance across simulators and real-world settings.

Abstract: Simulation demonstrations can supplement scarce real-world data for robot policy co-training. However, the value of using data curation to actively select these demonstrations for sim-to-real co-training remains underexplored. Existing curation methods also lack a unified criterion for measuring trajectory-level utility and set-level coverage from closed-loop target behavior. To address these gaps, we present the first systematic study of data curation for sim-to-real robot policy co-training and propose Trajectory-level Utility and set-level Coverage Optimization (TUCO). TUCO uses influence functions to trace how each source demonstration affects target-domain scoring rollouts. Our key insight is that these effects can be decomposed into an overall contribution to target return and variation across rollouts, providing a common closed-loop basis for measuring trajectory utility and set coverage. We further propose a performance-aligned subset optimizer that combines these measures in a unified curation objective to reduce redundancy and select complementary demonstrations. Extensive experiments on RoboMimic and OmniReset establish the value of active simulation data curation for sim-to-real policy co-training and show that TUCO achieves state-of-the-art performance across single-simulator, sim-to-sim, and sim-to-real settings.

摘要（中文）：模拟演示可以补充机器人策略协同训练中稀缺的真实世界数据。然而，利用数据筛选来主动选择这些演示以用于仿真到现实协同训练的价值尚未得到充分探索。现有的筛选方法也缺乏统一的准则来衡量闭环目标行为下的轨迹级效用和集合级覆盖度。为填补这些空白，我们首次系统性地研究了仿真到现实机器人策略协同训练中的数据筛选问题，并提出了轨迹级效用与集合级覆盖度优化方法（TUCO）。TUCO利用影响函数追溯每条源演示如何影响目标域评分轨迹。我们的关键洞见在于，这些影响可以分解为对目标回报的整体贡献以及在不同轨迹间的变异，从而为衡量轨迹效用和集合覆盖度提供了统一的闭环基础。我们进一步提出了一种性能对齐的子集优化器，将这些度量在统一的筛选目标中结合起来，以减少冗余并选择互补的演示。在RoboMimic和OmniReset上的大量实验验证了主动仿真数据筛选在仿真到现实策略协同训练中的价值，并表明TUCO在单仿真器、仿真到仿真以及仿真到现实等多种设置下均达到了最先进的性能。

Authors: Ning Zhu, Mengfei Zhao, Yikai Tang, Zhangyujie Sun, Peihao Li, Dongyue Ni, Jindou Jia, Jianfei Yang

VAMPS: Visual and Motor Policies from Sampling-Based Planning Manipulation

MPPI control policy learning visuomotor policies sim-to-real transfer force-aware manipulation

简要说明：VAMPS利用MPPI控制在没有人类示范的情况下训练可复用机器人策略，通过迭代优化实现仿真到现实的Unitree Go2运动策略迁移，并利用离线数据训练Flexiv Rizon 10S的视觉运动策略，用于抓取和力感知擦除任务。

TLDR: VAMPS trains reusable robot policies using MPPI control without human demonstrations, applying iterative refinement for simulation-to-real locomotion with a Unitree Go2 and offline training of visuomotor policies for pick-and-place and force-aware erasing on a Flexiv Rizon 10S.

Abstract: Learning robot policies directly on physical systems remains difficult because data collection is costly and policy exploration can be unsafe. We introduce Visual and Motor Policies from Sampling-Based Planning (VAMPS), a framework that uses Model Predictive Path Integral (MPPI) control to train reusable policies without human demonstrations. VAMPS supports two training modes. For one-step proprioceptive policies, it operates iteratively in simulation: the policy warm-starts MPPI, and the refined trajectories provide new supervision as the policy changes. A learned terminal value improves short-horizon planning, while an Implicit Q-Learning (IQL) critic guides the policy update. Iterative refinement outperforms training once on frozen MPPI data, and we transfer the learned locomotion policy to a Unitree Go2. For visuomotor policies, VAMPS operates directly from real-robot data. MPPI uses task-specific state estimates to plan and execute trajectories while recording RGB and sensor observations on a Flexiv Rizon 10S. Action Chunking with Transformers predicts action chunks, reducing the effective prediction horizon, and is trained offline on this fixed dataset. We demonstrate visuomotor pick-and-place and force-aware whiteboard erasing. In the latter task, the policy additionally observes the measured $6$-D wrench and desired normal force. These results show that VAMPS can learn policies either in simulation followed by hardware transfer or directly from autonomously collected real-robot data.

摘要（中文）：在物理系统上直接学习机器人策略仍然十分困难，因为数据采集成本高昂，且策略探索可能存在安全风险。我们提出了一种基于采样规划的视觉与运动策略框架（VAMPS），该框架利用模型预测路径积分（MPPI）控制，在无需人工示范的情况下训练可复用策略。VAMPS支持两种训练模式。对于单步本体感觉策略，框架在仿真中迭代运行：策略为MPPI提供热启动，随着策略更新，优化后的轨迹提供新的监督信号。学习到的终端价值函数改善了短视域规划，而隐式Q学习（IQL）评论网络则引导策略更新。迭代优化优于在固定MPPI数据上的一次性训练，我们将学习到的运动策略迁移至Unitree Go2机器人。对于视觉运动策略，VAMPS直接基于真实机器人数据运行。MPPI利用任务特定的状态估计来规划和执行轨迹，同时在Flexiv Rizon 10S上记录RGB图像和传感器数据。基于Transformer的动作分块（Action Chunking）预测动作块，从而缩短有效预测时域，并在该固定数据集上进行离线训练。我们展示了视觉运动抓取与放置任务，以及力感知白板擦拭任务。在后一任务中，策略额外观测实测六维力/力矩以及期望法向力。这些结果表明，VAMPS既可在仿真中学习策略后迁移至硬件，也可直接从自主采集的真实机器人数据中学习策略。

Authors: Mohamed Yassine Kabouri, Pietro Noah Crestaz, Quang-Nam Nguyen, Qilong Cheng, Ludovic Righetti, Nicolas Mansard

CoDance: Learning Reactive and Compliant Human-Humanoid Interaction from Video HumanoidEmbodied

video retargeting compliance augmentation partnered dancing reactive policy humanoid robot

简要说明：CoDance从视频中学习反应性与顺从性的人-人形机器人搭档舞蹈，通过多连杆顺应性增强训练策略，使真实人形机器人能适应舞伴步伐并对物理交互力作出回应。

TLDR: CoDance learns reactive and compliant human-humanoid partnered dancing from video, using multi-link compliance augmentation to train policies that adapt footsteps and respond to physical interaction forces on a real humanoid robot.

Abstract: Partnered human-humanoid interaction couples locomotion with continuous physical contact. A humanoid needs to coordinate with a person's motion while responding to interaction forces and maintaining stable and natural movement. We present CoDance, a framework for learning reactive and compliant human-humanoid interaction from video. We study partnered dancing as a challenging instantiation, where a humanoid coordinates its footsteps with a moving partner and maintains continuous two-hand contact. Given a single video of two human dancers, CoDance retargets their motions into a robot reference and a moving partner. We introduce a multi-link compliance augmentation that transforms the kinematic demonstration into force-aware training data by adapting the robot reference under structured forces at both hands. Policies trained on this data follow the observed partner while preserving the demonstrated locomotion style and responding compliantly to physical interaction. In simulation, the policies adapt their footsteps to changes in the partner and reproduce approximately 80% of the wrist displacement encoded by the augmented demonstrations. On a physical humanoid, CoDance enables sustained two-hand dancing with a human partner including repeated transitions between forward and backward motions.

摘要（中文）：人机共舞交互将行走与持续的身体接触相结合。类人机器人需要在响应交互力的同时，与人的动作保持协调，并维持稳定、自然的运动。我们提出了CoDance，一个从视频中学习反应性且柔顺的人机交互框架。我们以双人舞蹈作为具有挑战性的实例进行研究，其中类人机器人需要与移动的舞伴协调步伐，并保持持续的双手接触。给定一段两位人类舞者的单段视频，CoDance将他们的动作重定向到机器人参考动作和一个移动的舞伴上。我们引入了一种多连杆柔顺增强方法，通过在双手处施加结构化力来调整机器人参考动作，从而将运动学演示转化为力感知的训练数据。基于这些数据训练的策略能够跟随所观察到的舞伴，同时保持所演示的行走风格，并对物理交互做出柔顺响应。在仿真中，这些策略能够根据舞伴的变化调整步伐，并复现由增强演示所编码的约80%的手腕位移。在实体类人机器人上，CoDance实现了与人类舞伴的持续双手共舞，包括前后移动之间的反复转换。

Authors: Zhuoqun Chen, Shucheng Jia, Boyuan Chen

When and What to Prune? Stage-Aware Visual Token Pruning for Efficient VLA VLA

visual token pruning vision-language-action efficient inference attention reliability dual-path pruning

简要说明：SAPrune 提出一种无需训练的、阶段感知的视觉token剪枝框架，通过评估动作-视觉注意力的可靠性来决定何时剪枝，并采用双路径策略保留重要和上下文token，在保持任务成功率的同时大幅减少token量并提升推理速度。

TLDR: SAPrune proposes a training-free, stage-aware visual token pruning framework for VLA models that determines when to prune based on action-to-visual attention reliability and uses a dual-path rule to retain both salient and contextual tokens, enabling significant token reduction and inference speedup while maintaining task success rates.

Abstract: Visual token pruning is an effective way to accelerate vision-language models and is especially useful for vision-language-action (VLA) inference, where many visual tokens must be processed before predicting robot actions. Existing pruning methods usually estimate which tokens can be pruned based on attention scores or feature diversity, retaining tokens that are either highly attended or visually different from others. However, most of them use fixed pruning schedules, such as pruning once at a preset layer or pruning at uniformly spaced layers. Such schedules can be risky for VLA models, because the model may not know which visual regions matter for the action in early layers. Tokens that look unimportant at first may become useful after the model combines visual observations with the language instruction. In this work, we propose SAPrune, a training-free visual token pruning framework for efficient VLA inference. Instead of pruning at fixed layers, SAPrune uses a small calibration set to observe how action-to-visual attention changes across layers, and chooses pruning layers only after the attention pattern becomes more reliable. At each selected layer, SAPrune applies a dual-path pruning rule: one path protects strongly attended visual tokens from pruning, while the other prevents useful surrounding context from being discarded. Experiments on LIBERO, SIMPLER, and real-world robotic tasks show that SAPrune prunes 87.5% of visual tokens and achieves up to 1.718x inference speedup while maintaining competitive task success rates.

摘要（中文）：视觉标记剪枝是加速视觉-语言模型的一种有效方法，对于视觉-语言-动作（VLA）推理尤其有用，因为在预测机器人动作之前需要处理大量视觉标记。现有的剪枝方法通常基于注意力分数或特征多样性来估计哪些标记可以被剪除，保留那些被高度关注或在视觉上与其他标记不同的标记。然而，大多数方法使用固定的剪枝调度，例如在预设层剪枝一次或在均匀间隔的层进行剪枝。这种调度对VLA模型可能存在风险，因为模型在早期层可能不知道哪些视觉区域对动作至关重要。最初看似不重要的标记在模型将视觉观察与语言指令结合后可能会变得有用。在这项工作中，我们提出了SAPrune，一种无需训练的视觉标记剪枝框架，用于高效的VLA推理。SAPrune不在固定层进行剪枝，而是使用一个小型校准集来观察动作到视觉的注意力在各层间的变化，仅在注意力模式变得更加可靠后选择剪枝层。在每个选定的层，SAPrune应用双路径剪枝规则：一条路径保护被高度关注的视觉标记免于被剪除，另一条路径防止有用的周围上下文被丢弃。在LIBERO、SIMPLER以及真实世界机器人任务上的实验表明，SAPrune剪除了87.5%的视觉标记，实现了高达1.718倍的推理加速，同时保持了有竞争力的任务成功率。

Authors: Tianjun Shi, Haotian Xiong, Ziyu Gong, Qi Lu, Li Li

VICON: Visual-Inertial-Contact based Hand-Object Tracking for Manipulation Datasets Manipulation

hand-object tracking contact sensing factor graph RGB-D dexterous manipulation dataset

简要说明：VICON 是一个视觉-惯性-接触框架，可在严重遮挡下联合跟踪手和物体的运动并捕获接触力，用于构建丰富的操作数据集。

TLDR: VICON is a visual-inertial-contact framework that jointly tracks hand and object motion and captures contact forces during dexterous manipulation, robust to severe occlusion, and enables the construction of a rich manipulation dataset.

Abstract: Learning dexterous manipulation benefits from human demonstration datasets that capture diverse and natural hand-object interactions. In particular, contact points and forces provide supervision on where and how strongly to interact, which cannot be fully captured by motion trajectories alone. However, methods for jointly capturing hand and object motion, contact points, and forces remain limited. Moreover, severe occlusion from hand-object interaction challenges accurate tracking of both hands and objects. To address these limitations, we present a Visual-Inertial-CONtact based hand-object tracking (VICON) framework. It holistically captures both hand and object motion along with contact information during manipulation, even under severe occlusion. First, we adopt a visual-inertial glove and an RGB-D camera for accurate hand tracking, and redesign the glove to incorporate contact sensing. Specifically, force-sensitive resistors (FSRs) are placed on the glove based on human grasp frequency to synchronously record contact states and calibrated normal forces. Second, without requiring pre-existing CAD models, we estimate object poses using RGB-D images and a mesh reconstructed from a monocular video. We propose factor-graph-based object trajectory estimation that fuses object-pose estimates weighted by visibility under hand-object occlusion, FSR measurements, and a hand-motion prior. Across 40 motion-capture sessions with five objects, VICON achieves a 2.5% failed-frame rate compared with 50.9-64.6% for the baselines, with median errors of 3.9 mm and 3.0 degrees under occlusion. Using VICON, we construct a dataset containing synchronized hand-object motion, contact points, and normal forces, and will publicly release an expanded dataset covering 10 object categories at https://github.com/VICON-dataset/dataset.

摘要（中文）：学习灵巧操作可以从人类演示数据集中受益，这些数据集捕捉了多样且自然的手物交互。特别是，接触点和接触力提供了交互位置和交互强度的监督信息，而这些信息无法仅通过运动轨迹完整获取。然而，能够同时捕捉手和物体的运动、接触点以及接触力的方法仍然十分有限。此外，手物交互造成的严重遮挡也对手和物体的精确追踪构成了挑战。为解决这些局限，我们提出了一种基于视觉-惯性-接触的手物追踪（VICON）框架。该框架能够在操作过程中全面捕捉手和物体的运动以及接触信息，即使在严重遮挡下也能实现。首先，我们采用视觉-惯性手套和RGB-D相机以实现精确的手部追踪，并重新设计手套以集成接触感知功能。具体而言，根据人类抓取频率，在手套上布置力敏电阻（FSRs），以同步记录接触状态并标定法向力。其次，无需预设CAD模型，我们利用RGB-D图像和从单目视频重建的网格进行物体姿态估计。我们提出了基于因子图的物体轨迹估计方法，该方法融合了在手物遮挡下按可见性加权的物体姿态估计、FSR测量值以及手部运动先验。在包含五个物体的40次运动捕捉实验中，VICON的失败帧率为2.5%，而基线方法的失败帧率为50.9%-64.6%，在遮挡条件下的中位误差为3.9毫米和3.0度。利用VICON，我们构建了一个包含同步手物运动、接触点和法向力的数据集，并将在https://github.com/VICON-dataset/dataset上公开发布覆盖10个物体类别的扩展数据集。

Authors: Yubin Jeon, Uiseong Shin, Hwanchul La, Jaeseong Kang, Hyelim Choi, Yongseok Lee

A Safe Action Is Not Enough: Feasible-Future Decoding for Vision-Language-Action Policies VLA

feasible-future decoding VLA policies safety reranker training-free

简要说明：本文提出了VICS-G，一种无需训练的、由警报触发的重新排序器，用于为冻结的视觉-语言-动作(VLA)策略解码可行未来动作，在不重新训练的情况下显著降低了安全成本。

TLDR: This paper introduces VICS-G, a training-free, alarm-triggered reranker that decodes feasible-future actions for frozen VLA policies, significantly reducing safety costs without retraining.

Abstract: A safe action is not necessarily a viable one. Under a frozen vision-language-action (VLA) policy, an action can be likely and locally admissible yet leave no policy-supported route to safe task completion. We call this the feasibility-likelihood gap: likelihood ranks the current action, whereas feasibility depends on the futures that remain after it. We derive the exact next-block marginal of the history-conditioned policy-environment trajectory law restricted to safe task completion. The derivation exposes a candidate-dependent feasible-future mass with two roles: its support records whether safe completion remains possible under the frozen continuation process, and its magnitude measures how much weighted safe-completion mass is preserved. Exact evaluation is impractical online, so we develop a selective finite-candidate approximation, derive conditions for recovering the best retained viable candidate, and instantiate it as an alarm-triggered, training-free reranker. On Safety-CHORES, VICS-G lowers mean cumulative safety cost by 1.9%-57.5% across six settings while remaining within 2.5 percentage points of policy sampling in success and 0.82 steps in mean episode length. The resulting decoder is tied to an exact policy-relative safe-completion target, yet requires neither retraining of the base policy nor online trajectory rollouts.

摘要（中文）：安全动作未必是可行动作。在冻结的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略下，某个动作可能是高概率的且局部可行的，但未必存在任何由策略支持的通向安全任务完成的路径。我们称此为可行性-似然差距：似然度对当前动作进行排序，而可行性则取决于该动作之后剩余的未开发路径。 我们推导了在限定安全任务完成条件下，历史条件策略-环境轨迹律的精确下一块边缘分布。该推导揭示了一个候选依赖的可行未来质量，其具有双重作用：其支撑集记录在冻结延续过程下安全完成是否仍然可能，其量级衡量保留的加权安全完成任务质量有多少。由于在线精确评估不切实际，我们开发了一种选择性有限候选近似方法，推导出恢复最优保留可行候选的条件，并将其实现为一种告警触发、无需训练的重新排序器。 在Safety-CHORES基准上，VICS-G在六种设置下将平均累积安全成本降低了1.9%至57.5%，同时在成功率上保持在策略采样的2.5个百分点以内，在平均轨迹长度上保持在0.82步以内。所得到的解码器与精确的策略相对安全完成目标相关联，但既不需要重新训练基础策略，也不需要在线轨迹推演。

Authors: Tu Nguyen, Matthieu Zimmer, Vu Anh Vu, Ziyi Wang, Jannik Hammel Nielsen, Xuebing Zhou, Haitham Bou Ammar

Now You Feel It, Now You See Me: Digital-Twin-based Teleoperation Interface for Dexterous Manipulation Manipulation

dexterous manipulation teleoperation augmented reality digital twin force feedback

简要说明：本文提出了一种基于数字孪生的增强现实遥操作界面，用于灵巧操作，集成了裸手追踪、双臂机器人手和虚拟表示，以提供视觉力反馈和缓解遮挡的视觉反馈，并通过涉及力调节和遮挡任务的用户研究进行了评估。

TLDR: This paper presents a digital-twin-based AR teleoperation interface for dexterous manipulation that integrates bare-hand tracking, bimanual robotic hands, and virtual representations to provide visuo-force feedback and occlusion-mitigating visual feedback, evaluated through user studies with force regulation and occlusion tasks.

Abstract: Teleoperation is becoming increasingly important for collecting high-quality demonstrations to teach robots dexterous manipulation skills. For dexterous manipulation, bare-hand tracking provides a practical way to control robotic hands and demonstrate coordinated finger movements without gloves or exoskeletons. However, this type of teleoperation faces two key feedback limitations: a lack of force feedback and visual feedback of occluded region. The absence of force feedback hinders precise and safe manipulation, as operators must infer contact force visually rather than feel them directly. Occlusion by objects or other robot parts impairs the assessment of hand positions, approach distances, and pre-grasp configurations suited to the object's shape. To address these limitations, we propose a digital-twin-based augmented reality (AR) teleoperation interface that integrates bare-hand tracking, bimanual robotic hands, and virtual representations of the robot and task objects. The interface renders tactile measurements on robot hand meshes as visuo-force feedback. Furthermore, it offers a user-controlled virtual view panel or occlusion-aware transparency rendering to provide occlusion-mitigating visual feedback. We evaluated the interface through user studies involving Task 1 and Task 2, examining how force visualization and visual assistance support demonstration collection in tasks requiring careful force regulation and manipulation under occlusion.

摘要（中文）：遥操作在收集高质量示范以教导机器人灵巧操作技能方面正变得越来越重要。对于灵巧操作而言，裸手追踪提供了一种无需手套或外骨骼即可控制机械手并示范协调手指运动的实用方式。然而，这类遥操作面临两个关键的反馈局限：缺乏力反馈以及遮挡区域的视觉反馈。力反馈的缺失阻碍了精确且安全的操作，因为操作者必须通过视觉推断接触力，而非直接感知力。物体或其他机器人部件的遮挡则妨碍了对手部位置、接近距离及适合物体形状的预抓取构型的评估。为解决这些局限，我们提出了一种基于数字孪生的增强现实（AR）遥操作界面，该界面集成了裸手追踪、双手机器人手以及机器人和任务物体的虚拟表示。该界面将机器人手网格上的触觉测量值渲染为视觉-力反馈。此外，它提供了用户可控的虚拟视角面板或遮挡感知的透明渲染，以提供减轻遮挡影响的视觉反馈。我们通过涉及任务1和任务2的用户研究对该界面进行了评估，考察了力可视化和视觉辅助在需要精细力调节及遮挡条件下操作的示范收集任务中的支持效果。

Authors: Youngchan Shim, Kyutae Lee, JooYun Kim, Jaeseong Hwang, Harim Ji, Yongseok Lee

GeoBridge-VLA: Geometry-Aware Residual Adaptation for Vision-Language-Action Models VLA

Vision-Language-Action geometry-aware residual adaptation depth supervision robot manipulation

简要说明：GeoBridge-VLA 提出了一种两阶段方法，通过深度监督从冻结的 VLA 视觉编码器中学习几何特征，并使用门控残差接口增强视觉 token，从而在 LIBERO 和实体机器人上提升操作成功率，且测试时无需深度输入。

TLDR: GeoBridge-VLA introduces a two-stage method to learn geometric features from a frozen VLA visual encoder via depth supervision, and augments visual tokens with a gated residual interface to improve manipulation success on LIBERO and a real robot without requiring depth at test time.

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models encode semantic information from vision-language pretraining, but manipulation also requires precise spatial reasoning. We present GeoBridge-VLA, a two-stage method for learning geometric features from a pretrained VLA's frozen visual encoder and using them for action prediction. Stage I trains a feature bridge and geometry decoder with depth supervision. Stage II freezes these modules and trains a gated residual interface together with the action-side projections and action expert. The residual augments the existing visual tokens without adding a second image encoder or increasing the token count. Deployment requires RGB, robot state, and language, but no depth observations. Under matched evaluation conditions, GeoBridge-VLA achieves 70.9% success on LIBERO, compared with 60.0% for SmolVLA. Disabling the residual in the same trained checkpoint reduces success from 70.90% to 69.85%, with mixed effects across suites. On a physical ROBOTIS OMY robot, GeoBridge-VLA succeeds in 148 of 200 trials (74.0%) across four tasks, compared with 108 of 200 (54.0%) for SmolVLA.

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型从视觉-语言预训练中编码语义信息，但操作任务还需要精确的空间推理。我们提出GeoBridge-VLA，一种两阶段方法，从预训练VLA的冻结视觉编码器中学习几何特征，并将其用于动作预测。第一阶段训练特征桥接模块和几何解码器，并采用深度监督。第二阶段冻结这些模块，训练门控残差接口以及动作侧投影和动作专家模块。该残差机制增强现有视觉令牌，无需添加第二图像编码器或增加令牌数量。部署时仅需RGB图像、机器人状态和语言指令，不需要深度观测。在匹配的评估条件下，GeoBridge-VLA在LIBERO基准上达到70.9%的成功率，而SmolVLA为60.0%。在相同训练检查点中禁用残差模块后，成功率从70.90%降至69.85%，且在各任务套件上呈现混合影响。在实体ROBOTIS OMY机器人上，GeoBridge-VLA在四个任务的200次试验中成功148次（74.0%），而SmolVLA为200次中成功108次（54.0%）。

Authors: Hyun Song, Kangmin Kim, Loren Jinsoo Um, Minhui Han, Jaehyeok Park, Taewan Cho, Andrew Jaeyong Choi

LightVLN: Efficient Aerial Vision-and-Language Navigation with Compact Memory and History-Guided Local Aggregation VLN

aerial vision-and-language navigation lightweight policy compact memory history-guided local aggregation onboard deployment

简要说明：LightVLN提出了一种轻量级空中视觉语言导航框架，采用0.5B语言骨干、每个历史帧压缩为一个token的紧凑记忆和基于历史-指令的局部聚合，在OpenFly和AerialVLN-S上取得较好成功率，并在DJI M350 RTK上实现实时机载推理。

TLDR: LightVLN introduces a lightweight aerial VLN framework with a 0.5B language backbone, compact memory (one token per historical frame), and history-conditioned local aggregation for current observation tokens, achieving strong success rates on OpenFly and AerialVLN-S and enabling real-time onboard inference on a DJI M350 RTK with Jetson Orin NX.

Abstract: Aerial vision-and-language navigation (VLN) enables unmanned aerial vehicles to execute long-horizon natural-language instructions from visual observations in complex three-dimensional environments. However, recent aerial VLN models often rely on large-scale vision-language backbones and dense visual histories, imposing substantial computation and memory costs that hinder onboard deployment. We propose LightVLN, a lightweight history-aware aerial VLN framework that combines a compact 0.5B language backbone with compact representations of both historical and current observations. LightVLN compresses each historical frame into a single token using visual features already computed by the policy. It further introduces history- and instruction-conditioned local aggregation to reduce the current observation from 256 to 32 visual tokens while preserving navigation-relevant spatial information. With up to 16 historical frames, the policy uses at most 48 observation-derived tokens. On the public OpenFly dataset, LightVLN achieves 50.93% Test-Seen and 36.14% Test-Unseen success rates (SR), outperforming the evaluated 7B language-backbone baselines on most reported metrics. It also achieves 25.83% SR on AerialVLN-S Val-Seen. In a reconstructed unseen campus, we deploy LightVLN on a DJI M350 RTK with an external Jetson Orin NX 16 GB for closed-loop onboard-compute real-to-sim hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) evaluation, achieving 14.61 Hz model inference and 11.13 Hz end-to-end decision updates. These results demonstrate the effectiveness and efficiency of LightVLN for aerial navigation.

摘要（中文）：摘要：空中视觉-语言导航（VLN）使无人驾驶飞行器能够在复杂的三维环境中，依据视觉观察执行长时间跨度的自然语言指令。然而，现有的空中VLN模型通常依赖大规模视觉-语言骨干网络和密集的视觉历史信息，带来了巨大的计算和内存开销，阻碍了机载部署。我们提出了LightVLN，一种轻量级历史感知空中VLN框架，结合了紧凑的0.5B语言骨干网络以及历史和当前观察的紧凑表示。LightVLN利用策略已计算的视觉特征，将每个历史帧压缩为单个标记。它进一步引入历史和指令条件局部聚合，将当前观察从256个视觉标记减少到32个，同时保留与导航相关的空间信息。在多达16个历史帧的情况下，策略最多使用48个派生自观察的标记。在公开的OpenFly数据集上，LightVLN达到了50.93%的Test-Seen和36.14%的Test-Unseen成功率（SR），在大多数报告指标上优于所评估的7B语言骨干基线。它还在AerialVLN-S Val-Seen上实现了25.83%的SR。在重建的未见校园中，我们使用DJI M350 RTK和外接Jetson Orin NX 16 GB部署LightVLN，进行闭环机载计算真实到仿真硬件在环（HIL）评估，实现了14.61 Hz的模型推理和11.13 Hz的端到端决策更新。这些结果证明了LightVLN在空中导航中的有效性和高效性。

Authors: Yiming Zhao, Tianshun Li, Jingle He, Ruonan Chai, Xinhu Zheng

DiVeR: Decision-Critical Verifier Learning for VLA Test-Time Scaling VLA

test-time scaling verifier learning decision criticality action selection VLA policy

简要说明：DiVeR通过学习决策关键验证器，在测试时缩放VLA策略，重点训练对动作选择影响最大的状态，在LIBERO、RoboCasa和真实Franka机器人上提升了任务成功率。

TLDR: DiVeR learns decision-critical verifiers for VLA test-time scaling by reweighting training toward states where action selection matters most, improving task success on LIBERO, RoboCasa, and real Franka robots.

Abstract: Scaling robot data and model capacity has improved Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies, but further progress is constrained by the high cost of robotic data. Verifier-guided test-time scaling offers an efficient alternative by sampling multiple action candidates and selecting the one most likely to lead to task success at inference time. Existing classification-based verifiers learn from trajectory-level outcomes but treat all visited states equally, even though their value for candidate discrimination can vary across a trajectory. At many states, plausible actions are similar and provide limited discrimination signal, while only a sparse set of decision-critical states admits meaningfully different actions that can substantially affect downstream outcomes. To address this, we propose DiVeR, which estimates decision criticality from the dispersion of sampled action representations. DiVeR then uses this signal to reweight verifier learning toward states where action selection is most consequential, without requiring step-level annotations or additional environment interaction. Across LIBERO, RoboCasa, and real-world experiments on a Franka Research 3 robot, DiVeR consistently improves task success through more effective verifier-guided action selection, while adding negligible verifier inference overhead.

摘要（中文）：扩展机器人数据和模型规模已提升了视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略的性能，但进一步的发展受到机器人数据高昂成本的制约。验证器引导的测试时扩展提供了一种高效的替代方案，即在推理时采样多个候选动作，并选择最有可能导致任务成功的那一个。现有的基于分类的验证器从轨迹级结果中学习，但将所有访问过的状态同等对待，尽管这些状态在候选动作区分方面的价值可能随轨迹变化而不同。在许多状态下，合理的动作彼此相似，提供的区分信号有限，而只有稀疏的一组决策关键状态才允许出现有意义的不同动作，这些动作可能显著影响后续结果。为解决这一问题，我们提出了DiVeR，该方法通过采样的动作表征的离散程度来估计决策关键性。DiVeR利用这一信号将验证器学习重新加权，聚焦于动作选择影响最大的状态，而无需逐步标注或额外的环境交互。在LIBERO、RoboCasa以及Franka Research 3机器人上的真实世界实验中，DiVeR通过更有效的验证器引导动作选择持续提升了任务成功率，同时仅增加了可忽略的验证器推理开销。

Authors: Seongheon Park, Heecheol Kim, Shulin Tian, Lilika Makabe, Namiko Saito, Katsushi Ikeuchi, Sharon Li, Yasuyuki Matsushita

Nudge Before You Push: Physics-Aware Navigation via Tactile Probing Manipulation

tactile probing mass estimation repeated-patrol planning quadruped manipulator physics-aware navigation

简要说明：TANav通过短暂的触觉推动来估计容器质量，提出物理感知导航系统TacPhys，在四足机械臂上减少了重复巡逻任务中的漏推和边界违反。

TLDR: TANav introduces a physics-aware navigation system that uses a brief tactile nudge to estimate container mass via a force-sequence model (TacPhys), reducing missed pushes and boundary violations in repeated-patrol tasks on a quadruped manipulator.

Abstract: Visually identical containers can conceal loads that require different handling decisions. We present TANav, which uses a brief nudge to measure push resistance for navigation under a site-defined handling boundary. TacPhys reads the force sequence, with optional RGB-D and kinematics, into a mass estimate for push authorization. A repeated-patrol planner weighs probe and route costs, requests a second contact when useful, and reuses observations across visits. In simulation, TacPhys approaches a resistance-only Bayes reference and reduces missed pushes from 28.7% to 5.5% relative to peak-force thresholding at comparable low-risk operating points. In repeated-patrol simulation, TANav recovers 90% of the oracle's path saving, more than halves human interventions relative to always-detour, and reduces boundary violations from 4.3% to 2.9% relative to RGB-D-only probing. On a quadruped manipulator with a Hall-array fingertip, offline zero-shot MAE is 0.28-1.07 kg on containers up to 2.82 kg. Force-rise calibration at 3 kg gives 93.5% pooled offline accuracy (86.4% on non-cube episodes); a separate raw-peak rule gives 15 of 20 correct online decisions on unseen boxes.

摘要（中文）：视觉上相同的容器可能隐藏着需要不同处理决策的负载。我们提出了TANav系统，该系统通过一次短暂的触碰来测量推力阻力，从而在场地限定的处理边界内进行导航。TacPhys将力序列（可选配RGB-D和运动学数据）读取为质量估计，用于推力授权。重复巡逻规划器权衡探测与路径成本，在有用时请求第二次接触，并在多次访问中复用观测结果。在仿真中，TacPhys接近仅基于阻力的贝叶斯参考性能，在相当的低风险工作点下，相对于峰值力阈值法，漏推率从28.7%降至5.5%。在重复巡逻仿真中，TANav恢复了最优策略路径节省的90%，与始终绕行相比，人工干预减少一半以上，并且相对于仅依赖RGB-D探测，边界违规率从4.3%降至2.9%。在配备霍尔阵列指尖的四足机械臂上，对不超过2.82 kg的容器，离线零样本平均绝对误差为0.28-1.07 kg。在3 kg下的力上升标定实现了93.5%的合并离线准确率（非立方体场景为86.4%）；单独的原始峰值规则在未见过的箱体上实现了20次在线决策中15次正确。

Authors: Xianyao Li, Fang Xu, Ruitong Tian, Bowen Sun, Xiao Hu, Yang Ye, Jing Du

PreAct-Nav: Agentic Reasoning Before Action for Urban Navigation VLN

agentic navigation action-conditioned world model vision-language model urban navigation subgoal reasoning

简要说明：PreAct-Nav提出了一个用于城市场景具身智能体导航的Agentic框架，通过导航记忆模块维护中期子目标，利用动作条件世界模型预测未来状态，并由VLM推理器进行决策，在长距离及多转弯路线上显著提升了行动选择的准确性。

TLDR: PreAct-Nav introduces an agentic navigation framework for urban embodied agents that uses a navigation memory module to maintain medium-horizon subgoals, an action-conditioned world model to forecast future states, and a VLM reasoner to make decisions, demonstrating improved action selection on long, turn-rich routes.

Abstract: Urban navigation requires embodied agents to pursue long-horizon goals through local decisions based on egocentric observations. However, existing agentic navigation methods often struggle to translate distant goals into coherent local decisions in large-scale physical environments. Their reliance on linguistic reasoning over transient observations or limited history constrains anticipation of the consequences of actions and future conditions, despite the importance of such foresight for navigating long and complex urban routes. To bridge this gap, we propose PreAct-Nav, an agentic navigation framework that equips frozen policies with anticipatory reasoning for robust urban navigation. Our central idea is to anchor local decisions in persistent medium-horizon subgoals, assess the consequences of predicted actions before execution, and continually update the reasoning context using actual outcomes. At its core, a navigation memory module maintains the active subgoal and relevant experience across decisions, translating distant goals into actionable intermediate objectives. We further introduce a predictive world sandbox that uses an action-conditioned world model (AC-WM) to forecast world dynamics conditioned on candidate movements. A vision-language model (VLM) reasoner interprets these predictions under the current subgoal to retain or revise actions. After execution, real observations are used to assess outcomes, correct inconsistent assumptions, and update memory to continue or reformulate the subgoal. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that the proposed PreAct-Nav improves action selection through memory updates and visual prediction, with more pronounced gains on longer routes and routes with more turns.

摘要（中文）：城市导航要求具身智能体基于自我中心观察，通过局部决策来追求长期目标。然而，现有的智能体导航方法在将遥远目标转化为大规模物理环境中的连贯局部决策时往往面临困难。尽管对行动后果和未来状况的前瞻性预判对于在漫长复杂的城市路线上导航至关重要，但这些方法依赖对瞬时观察或有限历史进行语言推理，限制了对行动后果及未来状况的预测能力。为弥合这一差距，我们提出了PreAct-Nav，一种智能体导航框架，为冻结策略赋予预期推理能力以实现稳健的城市导航。我们的核心思想是将局部决策锚定于持久的中间视野子目标，在执行前评估预测行动的后果，并利用实际结果持续更新推理上下文。其核心是一个导航记忆模块，该模块在决策之间维护当前活动子目标及相关经验，将遥远目标转化为可操作的中间目标。我们进一步引入了一个预测世界沙盒，利用动作条件世界模型（AC-WM）基于候选移动动作预测世界动态。视觉语言模型（VLM）推理器在当前子目标下解读这些预测，以保留或修正动作。执行后，利用真实观察评估结果，修正不一致的假设，并更新记忆以继续或重新设定子目标。大量实验评估表明，所提出的PreAct-Nav通过记忆更新和视觉预测改善了动作选择，在较长路线及转弯较多的路线上增益更为显著。

Authors: Jing Xie, Shouwei Ruan, Yubin Wang, Yuxiang Zhang, Junwei Yang, Songchang Jin, Dianxi Shi

$R^2$-WAM: Repair-and-Reject Post-Training for World Action Models WorldModel

World Action Models post-training negative fine-tuning robot manipulation policy refinement

简要说明：R^2-WAM 提出了一种针对世界动作模型的修复-拒绝后训练框架，提高动作一致性并利用负样本微调来增强机器人操作策略。

TLDR: R^2-WAM introduces a repair-and-reject post-training framework for World Action Models, improving action consistency and using negative fine-tuning to enhance policy refinement for robot manipulation.

Abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) emerge as a promising foundation for policy refinement by predicting the consequences of sampled actions. However, visually plausible predictions can mislead policy refinement if they fail to reflect the input actions. To address this mismatch, we introduce $R^2$-WAM, a two-stage repair-and-reject post-training framework that first improves the consistency of predicted futures with input actions, then uses these futures to select inferior action samples for negative fine-tuning. The repair stage grounds imagination in observed robot behavior through a kinematic alignment score that measures agreement between predicted and demonstrated motion, enabling the predicted video to faithfully reflect its input actions. Using the repaired video model, the rejection stage compares imagined outcomes of sampled and demonstrated actions, selectively applying negative fine-tuning to samples whose predicted task progress falls below the demonstrated reference by a prescribed margin. Together, the two stages extend video prediction from representation learning to consequence-based policy refinement without additional environment interaction or changes to the inference procedure. $R^2$-WAM achieves 93.8% average success on RoboTwin 2.0 across clean and randomized settings. On the long-horizon real-world Fold Shirt task, it achieves 87.5% average success, compared with 0% for Fast-WAM.

摘要（中文）：世界动作模型（WAMs）通过预测采样动作的后果，为策略优化提供了有前景的基础。然而，若视觉上看似合理的预测未能反映输入动作，则可能误导策略优化。为解决这一不匹配问题，我们提出 \(R^2\)-WAM，一个两阶段的“修复-拒绝”后训练框架，该框架首先提升预测未来与输入动作的一致性，继而利用这些未来结果筛选劣质动作样本进行负向微调。修复阶段通过运动学对齐分数将想象建立在观察到的机器人行为之上，该分数衡量预测运动与演示运动之间的一致性，从而使预测视频能够忠实地反映其输入动作。利用修复后的视频模型，拒绝阶段比较采样动作与演示动作的想象结果，选择性地对预测任务进展低于演示基准达到规定阈值的样本施加负向微调。两个阶段共同将视频预测从表征学习拓展至基于后果的策略优化，无需额外的环境交互或对推理过程的修改。在RoboTwin 2.0的干净与随机化设置中，\(R^2\)-WAM 实现了93.8%的平均成功率。在长时程真实世界折叠衬衫任务中，其平均成功率达到87.5%，而Fast-WAM仅为0%。

Authors: Ruiyan Xu, Haisheng Su, Sixu Lin, Zhaokun Yue, Chengming Hu, Xin Jin, Guiliang Liu

ExStereo: Lifting 2D Vision-Language-Action Models to 3D with Explicit Stereo Representations VLA

stereo matching vision-language-action model 3D perception cross-attention bimanual manipulation

简要说明：ExStereo 通过立体视觉模块和交叉注意力机制，将预训练的二维 VLA 模型提升为具有三维感知能力的机器人操作策略，并在仿真和真实双臂平台上验证了有效性。

TLDR: ExStereo augments pre-trained 2D VLA models with 3D perception by reconstructing scene geometry from stereo pairs, using a stereo module with cross-attention, and validating on simulated and real bimanual manipulation tasks.

Abstract: Three-dimensional perception is critical for robotic manipulation, particularly for high-precision tasks, as recovering metric depth and precise 3D object positions from monocular RGB observations is inherently ill-posed. However, many Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models rely solely on RGB observations for perception. Leveraging recent advances in foundation models for stereo matching, we introduce ExStereo, a stereo module that augments pre-trained 2D VLAs with 3D perception. ExStereo reconstructs scene geometry from stereo image pairs and renders multi-view observations as an explicit stereo representation for stereo feature extraction. The action tokens from the action expert selectively attend to the resulting stereo tokens through our proposed action-stereo cross-attention mechanism, enabling the policy to generate robot actions conditioned on 3D scene information. To learn robust 3D representations, we introduce a mid-training stage before task-specific post-training, using a self-supervised learning objective on large-scale stereo data. We validate our approach by fine-tuning two publicly available VLAs, $π_{0.5}$ and SmolVLA, and evaluate them in simulation and on a real-world bimanual PiPER platform. Across both settings, VLAs fine-tuned with ExStereo consistently outperform baselines, demonstrating the effectiveness of stereo perception for robotic manipulation. Our project website is at: https://exstereo-vla.github.io/ExStereo/.

摘要（中文）：三维感知对于机器人操作至关重要，尤其是在高精度任务中，因为从单目RGB观测中恢复度量深度和精确的三维物体位置本质上是不适定问题。然而，许多视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型仅依赖RGB观测进行感知。利用立体匹配基础模型的最新进展，我们提出了ExStereo，这是一个立体模块，可为预训练的二维VLA模型增强三维感知能力。ExStereo从立体图像对中重建场景几何，并将多视角观测渲染为显式立体表示，用于立体特征提取。动作专家生成的动作令牌通过我们提出的动作-立体交叉注意力机制，选择性地关注生成的立体令牌，从而使策略能够基于三维场景信息生成机器人动作。为了学习鲁棒的三维表示，我们在任务特定的后训练之前引入了一个中期训练阶段，在大规模立体数据上使用自监督学习目标。我们通过微调两个公开可用的VLA模型$π_{0.5}$和SmolVLA来验证我们的方法，并在仿真环境和真实世界的双臂PiPER平台上进行评估。在两种设置下，使用ExStereo微调的VLA模型始终优于基线，证明了立体感知对机器人操作的有效性。我们的项目网站位于：https://exstereo-vla.github.io/ExStereo/。

Authors: I-Chun Arthur Liu, Jason Chen, Gaurav S. Sukhatme, Daniel Seita

Learning Task and Motion Plans from Real Demonstrations with Hybrid Flow Matching Manipulation

hybrid flow matching generative planner mobile manipulation task and motion planning closed-loop replanning

简要说明：本文提出了一种混合流匹配规划器，从少量真实演示中生成符号任务计划和运动轨迹，用于长视野移动操作，支持闭环重新规划并在真实机器人上验证。

TLDR: This paper introduces a hybrid flow matching planner that generates symbolic task plans and motion trajectories from a small set of real demonstrations for long-horizon mobile manipulation, enabling closed-loop replanning and validation on a real robot.

Abstract: Long-horizon mobile manipulation requires a task plan and the motion that executes it. Generative planners trained on demonstration produce both in one pass, requiring neither a symbolic domain nor search. To date, however, they have relied on thousands of scripted demonstrations of fixed-base arms and executed open loop. This paper presents a hybrid flow matching planner: a single network generates the symbolic plan with masked discrete flow matching and the motion trajectory with continuous flow matching. Unlike prior generative planners, we aim to learn from a much smaller set of demonstrations and to execute the plan in closed loop. Two properties of the data compensate for the small dataset. A demonstration resumed from any of its intermediate actions is itself a demonstration, which multiplies the training samples and enables replanning after every action. Objects of the same kind are interchangeable, which turns demonstrations of one goal into demonstrations of every permuted goal. Our base implementation produces valid plans on 68% of held-out scenes; a training and generation scheme for the discrete plan raises this to 76%, and replanning after every action raises the task completion rate from 40% to 53% in a kinematic simulation. The planner matches the task completion rate of motion-only flow matching policies while additionally providing the symbolic plan, and it outperforms previous hybrid diffusion formulations on both task completion and plan validity. We validate the planner on a real mobile manipulator. Videos and project page: https://andreumatoses.github.io/research/hybrid-flow-planning

摘要（中文）：长时程移动操作任务需要任务规划与执行该规划的运动控制。基于示范训练生成的规划器能够一步生成两者，既不需要符号域定义，也无需搜索过程。然而，迄今为止，这类规划器依赖数千条固定基座机械臂的脚本化示范，并且以开环方式执行。本文提出一种混合流匹配规划器：单一网络通过掩码离散流匹配生成符号规划，通过连续流匹配生成运动轨迹。与先前的生成式规划器不同，我们的目标是从更小规模的示范集中学习，并以闭环方式执行规划。数据的两项特性弥补了小规模数据集带来的不足：从任意中间动作恢复的示范本身仍是一条有效示范，这既扩充了训练样本数量，也支持每个动作后的重新规划；同类物体具有可互换性，使得针对一个目标的示范可以转化为针对所有排列目标的示范。我们的基础实现在68%的留出场景中生成有效规划；针对离散规划设计的训练与生成方案将该比例提升至76%，而在运动学仿真中，每个动作后的重新规划将任务完成率从40%提升至53%。该规划器在任务完成率上与仅生成运动的流匹配策略相当，同时额外提供符号规划，并且在任务完成率和规划有效性两项指标上均优于先前的混合扩散方法。我们在真实移动操作平台上对规划器进行了验证。视频与项目页面：https://andreumatoses.github.io/research/hybrid-flow-planning

Authors: Zuleika Redondo Garcia, Andreu Matoses Gimenez, Javier Alonso-Mora

PatternDex: Learning Interaction Patterns to Guide Reinforcement Learning of Bimanual Dexterous Manipulation of Articulated Objects Manipulation

interaction pattern bimanual dexterous manipulation reinforcement learning embodiment gap articulated objects

简要说明：PatternDex 从人类演示中学习物体相关的交互模式，以指导双臂灵巧操作的强化学习，实现了高成功率并易于迁移到新的机器手。

TLDR: PatternDex learns object-dependent interaction patterns from human demonstrations to guide reinforcement learning for bimanual dexterous manipulation of articulated objects, achieving high success rates and easy transfer to new robot hands.

Abstract: In this paper, we develop a method that enables bimanual dexterous hands to manipulate articulated objects with a high success rate without suffering from an embodiment gap. We observe that the correlation between hand motions and object motions is dictated by the object rather than the hands and can be learned from human-object demonstrations. Based on this observation, we propose PatternDex, a method that learns this correlation and represents it as a token sequence, which we call an interaction pattern. From this pattern, PatternDex estimates the wrist motions and contact points that fit the target robot, and then trains a reinforcement learning policy that exploits these estimates as guidance. Since the guidance fits the target embodiment, the policy explores only the actions that the target robot can execute and thus achieves high success rates. PatternDex also requires only simple fine-tuning to train a new robot, since it can reuse the learned interaction pattern. We evaluate PatternDex with bimanual dexterous hands on human demonstrations from the ARCTIC dataset. PatternDex achieves, on average, a 92.8% success rate with Allegro hands, while the state-of-the-art baseline achieves 52.2%. Also, it achieves success rates above 70% with three other robot hands after fine-tuning alone. Furthermore, we verify that the learned policy transfers well to a real-world task of opening a microwave. Videos and additional results are available at https://patterndex.github.io/PatternDex/

摘要（中文）：在本研究中，我们提出了一种方法，使双臂灵巧手能够以高成功率操作关节物体，同时避免实体差异带来的影响。我们观察到，手部运动与物体运动之间的关联是由物体本身而非手部决定的，并且可以从人-物交互演示中学习得到。基于这一观察，我们提出了PatternDex方法，该方法学习这种关联并将其表示为一种令牌序列，我们称之为交互模式。根据该模式，PatternDex估算出适合目标机器人的手腕运动和接触点，然后训练一个强化学习策略，将这些估算结果作为引导信息加以利用。由于引导信息与目标实体相匹配，策略仅探索目标机器人能够执行的动作，从而实现高成功率。此外，PatternDex只需简单的微调即可训练新的机器人，因为它能够重用已学习的交互模式。我们使用ARCTIC数据集中的真人演示对双臂灵巧手进行了评估。实验结果显示，PatternDex在Allegro手上的平均成功率达到92.8%，而当前最先进的基线方法仅为52.2%。此外，仅经过微调后，该方法在另外三种机器人手上也取得了超过70%的成功率。我们还验证了学习到的策略能够很好地迁移到现实世界的微波炉开门任务中。视频与其他结果可在 https://patterndex.github.io/PatternDex/ 查看。

Authors: David Minkwan Kim, Runfa Blark Li, Beckham Po-Ju Lee, Nikolay Atanasov, Truong Nguyen

Robot Learning with Visual Predicted Force Manipulation

visual force prediction Fin Ray gripper action-force proposal policy contact-rich manipulation inference-time action selection

简要说明：本文提出一种通过视觉预测柔性夹爪变形来估计力的方法，从而在部署时无需力或触觉传感器即可实现力感知操作，并在多个接触密集任务中验证了其有效性。

TLDR: The paper introduces a method for force-aware manipulation using visual prediction of the force from a compliant gripper's deformation, eliminating the need for physical force or tactile sensors at deployment, and demonstrates its effectiveness on several contact-rich tasks.

Abstract: Force-aware manipulation typically relies on specialized force or tactile sensors. We show that force-aware manipulation can instead be achieved through visual force prediction from the deformation of a compliant Fin Ray gripper. Our approach trains two models. First, we train a visual force estimator on calibration data and use it to annotate task demonstrations with force estimates. Second, we train an action--force proposal policy on these force-augmented demonstrations to jointly generate candidate robot actions and their associated forces. At test time, we sample candidate actions and the forces they are expected to produce, then execute the action whose predicted force is closest to a target from the demonstrations. We evaluate our approach on berry picking, empty-can grasping, in-hand reorientation, and plug insertion. Our results show that visual force prediction can guide inference-time action selection for contact-rich manipulation without requiring force or tactile sensors at deployment.

摘要（中文）：力觉感知操作通常依赖于专用力传感器或触觉传感器。我们证明，通过利用柔性Fin Ray夹爪的形变进行视觉力预测，同样可以实现力觉感知操作。我们的方法训练两个模型。首先，我们在标定数据上训练一个视觉力估计器，并利用它为任务演示数据标注力估计值。其次，我们在这些带有力标注的演示数据上训练一个“动作-力”提议策略，以联合生成候选机器人动作及其对应的力。在测试阶段，我们采样候选动作及其预期产生的力，然后执行预测力与演示中目标力最接近的动作。我们在浆果采摘、空罐抓取、手内重定向和插头插入任务上评估了该方法。结果表明，视觉力预测能够在部署时无需力传感器或触觉传感器的情况下，引导接触密集操作中的推理阶段动作选择。

Authors: Haonan Chen, Feiyang Wu, Yuxiang Ma, Mustafa Mete, Pengfei Ye, Junxuan Shen, Cheng Zhu, Aurora Ruggeri, Kelvin Cheung, Jiayuan Mao, Edward Adelson, Jiajun Wu, Robert D. Howe, Yilun Du

Test-Time Training as Residual Memory for Robot Policies Manipulation

Test-Time Training Residual Memory Robot Manipulation Memory-Augmented Policies Long-Horizon Tasks

简要说明：本文提出TTT-RM，将测试时训练作为残差记忆，以补充有界记忆库，保留当前上下文无法恢复的任务相关历史信息，并在记忆密集型机器人操作基准和真实世界任务上展示性能提升。

TLDR: This paper introduces TTT-RM, a method that repurposes Test-Time Training (TTT) as residual memory to complement a bounded memory bank, preserving task-relevant historical information not recoverable from the current context, and demonstrates improved performance on memory-intensive robotic manipulation benchmarks and real-world tasks.

Abstract: Memory is essential for long-horizon robotic manipulation, where successful actions may depend on past events that are no longer recoverable from the current observation. As episodes grow longer, however, retaining the full history becomes increasingly costly, creating a fundamental scalability challenge for memory-augmented policies. Existing approaches address this challenge by either storing selected past observations in a bounded memory bank or compressing interaction history into a fixed-size parametric state through Test-Time Training (TTT). Yet these formulations do not explicitly distinguish between historical information that can already be recovered from the policy's current context and information that must persist beyond it. We introduce TTT-RM, which repurposes TTT as Residual Memory, using fast weights not to generically compress history but to complement a bounded memory bank by preserving task-relevant historical information that cannot be recovered from the policy's current context. Concretely, TTT-RM learns a history decoder that reconstructs historical representations from the current observation and retrieved memory. The resulting reconstruction residual captures what this context fails to explain and serves as the learning target for TTT. The TTT slow weights are optimized against this residual target so that online fast-weight updates learn to encode complementary historical information over time. The fast-weight state is then queried to produce a residual memory representation that conditions action generation. Extensive experiments on memory-intensive simulation benchmarks and real-world tasks show that TTT-RM consistently improves across multiple memory designs, outperforms diverse baselines, and supports sustained execution on a three-minute, eight-stage stowing task.

摘要（中文）：记忆对于长时间跨度的机器人操作任务至关重要，因为成功的动作可能依赖于当前观测中已无法恢复的过往事件。然而，随着任务片段不断延长，保留完整历史记录的代价日益高昂，这为记忆增强型策略带来了根本性的可扩展性挑战。现有方法通过两种途径解决该问题：一种是将选定的历史观测存储在有界记忆库中，另一种是通过测试时训练将交互历史压缩为固定尺寸的参数化状态。然而，这些方法并未明确区分那些已能从策略当前上下文中恢复的历史信息与必须超越当前上下文持续保留的信息。我们提出TTT-RM，将测试时训练重新定位为残差记忆，利用快速权重并非泛泛地压缩历史，而是通过保留策略当前上下文无法恢复的任务相关历史信息，对有界记忆库形成补充。具体而言，TTT-RM学习一个历史解码器，从当前观测和检索到的记忆中重建历史表征。由此产生的重建残差捕捉了当前上下文无法解释的部分，并作为测试时训练的学习目标。测试时训练的慢权重针对该残差目标进行优化，使得在线快速权重更新能够随着时间推移学习编码互补的历史信息。随后查询快速权重状态以生成残差记忆表征，用于条件化动作生成。在记忆密集型仿真基准和真实世界任务上的大量实验表明，TTT-RM在多种记忆设计下均能持续提升性能，超越多种基线方法，并支持在三分钟、八阶段的装载任务中持续执行。

Authors: Haoxuan Wang, Gengyu Zhang, Ramana Rao Kompella, Gaowen Liu, Yan Yan

Triggering Generalist Reasoning via Predictive Uncertainty for Dual-System VLA VLA

adaptive inference predictive uncertainty dual-system VLA efficient robot control generalist reasoning

简要说明：TUD是一种针对双系统VLA模型的自适应推理框架，利用预测不确定性信号选择性地跳过不必要的通用调用，在保持或提高成功率的同时改善成本-成功率权衡并减少计算量。

TLDR: TUD is an adaptive inference framework for dual-system VLA models that uses a predictive uncertainty signal to selectively skip unnecessary generalist calls, improving the cost-success trade-off and reducing computation while maintaining or improving success rates.

Abstract: Dual-system Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models improve real-time robotic control by pairing a slow, reasoning-capable generalist with a fast specialist action expert. However, existing methods invoke the generalist at a fixed frequency, ignoring the fact that decision-making complexity varies throughout a rollout. This static strategy wastes computation in easy phases and can delay renewed reasoning when the scene changes unexpectedly. We propose TUD (Triggering generalist reasoning via predictive Uncertainty for Dual-system VLA), an adaptive inference framework that selectively skips unnecessary generalist calls. TUD measures the cross-step dispersion of action re-predictions at the upcoming chunk slot under the cached generalist context, as a predictive uncertainty signal. This signal captures how much the future action plan shifts as new observations arrive and is computed from forwards the architecture already runs, requiring neither manual phase labels nor an auxiliary uncertainty model. On VLA-Arena, it achieves a higher success rate at matched call budgets than alternative uncertainty baselines while maintaining low wall-clock overhead, and more consistently separates successful from failed rollouts. Also, TUD finds a more favorable cost-success trade-off than non-adaptive baselines, tracing an entire operating curve as a single threshold is varied, and substantially reduces VLM calls at matched success rate. The same trade-off appears in our real-robot experiments, where TUD cuts generalist calls by 75% relative to the strongest fixed-interval baseline while achieving an even higher success rate. Our results suggest that predictive uncertainty provides a practical criterion for adaptive reasoning in efficient VLA control.

摘要（中文）：双系统视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型通过将具备慢速推理能力的通用模型与快速专用动作专家配对，提升了机器人实时控制性能。然而，现有方法以固定频率调用通用模型，忽略了整个交互过程中决策复杂度的动态变化。这种静态策略在简单阶段浪费计算资源，并在场景突变时延迟推理更新。我们提出TUD（基于预测不确定性触发双系统VLA通用模型推理），一种自适应推理框架，可选择性地跳过不必要的通用模型调用。TUD在缓存通用模型上下文条件下，度量下一动作片段位置上动作重预测的跨步分散度，作为预测不确定性信号。该信号捕捉随着新观测到达未来动作计划的变化程度，且仅利用架构已执行的前向计算，无需人工阶段标注或辅助不确定性模型。在VLA-Arena基准上，TUD在相同调用预算下取得了比替代不确定性基线更高的成功率，同时保持较低墙钟开销，并能更一致地区分成功与失败的交互轨迹。此外，TUD找到了比非自适应基线更优的成本-成功率权衡，通过调节单一阈值即可描绘完整运行曲线，并在匹配成功率下大幅减少VLM调用次数。该权衡同样体现在真实机器人实验中，TUD相较于最强固定间隔基线将通用模型调用减少75%，同时实现了更高的成功率。我们的结果表明，预测不确定性为高效VLA控制中的自适应推理提供了实用判据。

Authors: Hyemin Yang, Wooseong Jeong, Giwon Lee, Kuk-Jin Yoon

PWM: Personalized World Models with Online Reinforcement Learning WorldModel

world models online reinforcement learning LoRA action-conditioned generation scene customization

简要说明：PWM通过在线强化学习（GRPO或DiffusionNFT）将预训练的世界模型定制到用户提供的场景视频，使用冻结的Yume-5B骨干和LoRA适配器，提高了真实和渲染环境中动作条件生成的质量。

TLDR: PWM customizes pretrained world models to user-provided scene videos via online reinforcement learning with GRPO or DiffusionNFT, using a frozen Yume-5B backbone and LoRA adapter, improving action-conditioned generation fidelity across real and rendered environments.

Abstract: Pretrained world models can generate diverse environments, yet users often want to explore a particular scene specified by their own video. This requires learning the scene's visual identity while retaining the quality of action-conditioned generation. We introduce Personalized World Models (PWM), a framework for customizing interactive world models from short scene videos through online reinforcement learning. In PWM, the support trajectory and its associated controls provide reward feedback on continuations sampled from the current policy. In the GRPO instantiation, group-relative optimization updates a compact LoRA adapter using a unified reward for scene appearance, visual continuity, and motion, while base-policy anchoring regularizes changes to the pretrained generation prior of a frozen Yume-5B backbone. The same adaptation procedure is applied across real and rendered environments. We also instantiate PWM with DiffusionNFT as an alternative reward-guided optimization method for learning the scene-specific adapter. We also introduce PWM-Bench, comprising 150 customization tasks across Indoor, Outdoor, and Gaming, with paired evaluation on held-out continuations. The GRPO and DiffusionNFT instantiations of PWM improve customization over native Yume in 71.3% and 65.3% of the evaluated scenes, respectively, with positive mean gains across all three domains. For the GRPO instantiation, matched SFT comparisons further demonstrate higher mean customization gains and better mean image-quality scores in every domain, while retaining frame-level visual quality close to the pretrained model.

摘要（中文）：预训练的世界模型能够生成多样化的环境，但用户往往希望探索由其自身视频所指定的特定场景。这要求在学习场景视觉特征的同时，保持基于动作的条件生成质量。我们引入了个性化世界模型（Personalized World Models, PWM），这是一种通过在线强化学习从短视频场景中定制交互式世界模型的框架。在PWM中，支持轨迹及其相关控制为从当前策略采样的后续内容提供奖励反馈。在GRPO实例化中，组相对优化通过一个统一的奖励函数（涵盖场景外观、视觉连续性和运动）来更新紧凑的LoRA适配器，同时基础策略锚定机制对冻结的Yume-5B骨干网络的预训练生成先验变化进行正则化。同一适配流程适用于真实环境和渲染环境。我们还使用DiffusionNFT作为另一种奖励引导的优化方法来实例化PWM，以学习场景特定的适配器。此外，我们引入了PWM-Bench，包含跨室内、室外和游戏三个领域的150个定制任务，并在保留的后续内容上进行配对评估。PWM的GRPO和DiffusionNFT实例分别在71.3%和65.3%的评估场景中优于原生Yume的定制效果，且在三个领域中均实现了正向平均增益。对于GRPO实例化，匹配的SFT比较进一步表明，在每个领域中均获得了更高的平均定制增益和更好的平均图像质量分数，同时保持了接近预训练模型的帧级视觉质量。

Authors: Zhexin Lou, Guancheng Lu, Zeyu Zhang, Yi Zhang, Yang Zhao, Hao Tang

Optimal Control with Learned Critics under Unmodeled State Dependencies RLRobot

Model Predictive Control residual dynamics learned critic iLQR model-based reinforcement learning

简要说明：该论文提出了一种基于学习的MPC框架，通过残差动力学网络和学习到的动作价值评论器增强标称解析模型，并在GPU加速的批量iLQR求解器中进行优化，从而在不完整动力学下的机器人仿真中改善闭环控制性能。

TLDR: This paper introduces a learning-based MPC framework that augments a nominal analytical model with a residual dynamics network and a learned action-value critic within a GPU-accelerated batched iLQR solver, improving closed-loop control under incomplete dynamics in a robotics simulator.

Abstract: Model Predictive Control (MPC) provides a structured and constraint-aware mechanism for decision-making, but its reliance on optimization-friendly analytical dynamics models limits its use in tasks with contacts and other hard-to-model state dependencies. Model-free reinforcement learning avoids explicit modeling assumptions but typically requires large amounts of interaction data. We present a learning-based MPC framework that combines the data efficiency and structure of local model-based planning with learned components that compensate for incomplete dynamics and finite-horizon myopia. The method augments a nominal analytical model with a residual dynamics network that learns missing state-dependent effects from data and combines the resulting planner with a learned action-value critic that injects long-horizon MDP structure into the local iLQR optimization. To make this practical at reinforcement-learning scale, we develop a GPU-accelerated batched iLQR solver that evaluates learned dynamics and critic networks inside the optimal-control loop and solves thousands of trajectory-optimization problems in parallel. The complete system is integrated into a robotics simulator, enabling scalable model-based reinforcement learning under incomplete dynamics. Experiments on biased and incompletely modeled control tasks show that the approach improves closed-loop control performance while preserving the model-based structure needed for efficient constrained trajectory optimization.

摘要（中文）：模型预测控制（MPC）提供了一种结构化的、考虑约束的决策机制，但其对便于优化的解析动力学模型的依赖，限制了其在涉及接触及其他难以建模的状态依赖关系的任务中的应用。无模型强化学习虽然避免了显式的建模假设，但通常需要大量的交互数据。我们提出了一种基于学习的MPC框架，该框架将局部基于模型规划的样本效率与结构性，同用于补偿不完整动力学及有限时域短视性的学习组件相结合。该方法用残差动力学网络增强名义解析模型，该网络从数据中学习缺失的状态相关效应，并将所得规划器与学习得到的动作值评论员相结合，从而将长期马尔可夫决策过程结构注入局部iLQR优化中。为使该方法在强化学习规模下切实可行，我们开发了一种GPU加速的批处理iLQR求解器，该求解器在最优控制循环内评估学习的动力学与评论员网络，并并行求解数千个轨迹优化问题。完整系统已集成到机器人模拟器中，使得在不完整动力学条件下进行可扩展的基于模型的强化学习成为可能。在偏置且建模不完整的控制任务上的实验表明，该方法在保持高效约束轨迹优化所需的基于模型结构的同时，提升了闭环控制性能。

Authors: Philipp Schoch, Markus Ryll

Recursive Self-Improvement of Visuomotor Policies through Local Recovery Supervision Manipulation

recursive self-improvement local recovery supervision offline auditor visuomotor policies failure-state corrective demonstrations

简要说明：通过离线审计器识别失败状态、固定多模态教师生成局部恢复示范，递归改进视觉运动策略，在LIBERO-Goal和robomimic基准上显著提升成功率且仅部署学生模型。

TLDR: A framework recursively improves visuomotor policies by using an offline auditor to identify failures and a fixed multimodal teacher to generate local recovery demonstrations, leading to notable success-rate gains on LIBERO-Goal and robomimic benchmarks while keeping only the student deployed.

Abstract: Visuomotor policies can execute familiar tasks yet lack the corrective behavior needed after their own mistakes. We present a framework for recursive self-improvement through local recovery supervision. Each round audits the current policy, generates corrective demonstrations at supported failure states, and uses them to update the policy that drives the next round of collection. An offline auditor locates unresolved failures using coarse and dense temporal evidence and specifies observable repair goals. A fixed multimodal agent acts as a tool-using teacher, generating recovery actions through observation, computation, execution, and feedback. The frozen student tests whether each teacher endpoint supports further progress. If continuation fails, the system restores that endpoint and extends the demonstration. Action-level quality assessment then defines continuous training windows with aligned observations, quality weights, and validity masks. Only the student is deployed. In a preliminary LIBERO-Goal study, recovery-augmented post-training achieves 88 successful episodes out of 100 validation scenes, compared with 78 for original-data continuation from the same $π_0$ checkpoint. An earlier BC-RNN study on robomimic Can improves success from 102/130 to 112/130 using 26 local recovery segments. Both comparisons match 2,000 additional optimization steps.

摘要（中文）：视觉运动策略能够执行熟悉的任务，但在自身犯错后缺乏所需的纠正行为。我们提出了一种通过局部恢复监督实现递归自我改进的框架。每一轮迭代都会审查当前策略，在受支持的失败状态下生成纠正性演示，并利用这些演示来更新驱动下一轮数据收集的策略。离线审查器利用粗粒度与细粒度的时间证据定位未解决的失败，并指定可观察的修复目标。一个固定的多模态智能体充当使用工具的老师，通过观察、计算、执行和反馈生成恢复动作。冻结的学生模型测试每个教师端点是否支持进一步进展。如果继续推进失败，系统将恢复该端点并扩展演示。随后，动作级质量评估定义了包含对齐观察、质量权重和有效性掩码的连续训练窗口。只有学生模型被部署。在初步的LIBERO-Goal研究中，恢复增强的后训练在100个验证场景中实现了88个成功情节，而使用同一$π_0$检查点进行原始数据继续训练仅达到78个成功情节。早期在robomimic Can上的BC-RNN研究利用26个局部恢复片段将成功率从102/130提升至112/130。两项比较均匹配2,000次额外优化步骤。

Authors: Yuzhi Zhang, Xinyu Liu, Yu Zhang

Beyond LLM Serving: Characterizing Vision-Language-Action Workloads for Embodied AI System Design VLA

VLA workload characterization batch-1 inference edge GPU closed-loop episodes accuracy-speed-energy tradeoff

简要说明：本文在边缘GPU服务器和车载SoC上，以batch-1推理方式对四种视觉-语言-动作(VLA)模型进行了运行时特征分析，揭示了阶段级计算/内存瓶颈以及闭环部署中的精度-速度-能量权衡。

TLDR: This paper characterizes the runtime behavior of four Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models under batch-1 inference on edge GPU servers and onboard SoCs, revealing stage-level compute/memory bottlenecks and accuracy-speed-energy tradeoffs in closed-loop deployment.

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models translate multimodal observations into low-level robot actions. During robot operation, each control period sets an inference deadline, and overruns leave the robot acting on stale observations, reducing task success. Meeting this deadline motivates on-device or nearby edge execution, where a single robot requires batch-1 inference outside the design point of LLM serving systems. Although VLA architectures combine familiar vision-language, autoregressive, and diffusion-style components, their runtime behavior in this batch-1 control setting remains uncharacterized. We characterize four representative VLA models on an edge GPU server and two onboard SoCs, using single-inference profiling and 43,200 closed-loop episodes. Action tensor dimensionality determines whether a stage is memory- or compute-bound, platform balance can shift that bottleneck, and GPU frequency scaling yields a platform-dependent energy-latency sweet spot. In closed-loop operation, overlapping inference with action execution creates an accuracy-speed-energy tradeoff, and no configuration is Pareto-dominant across deployment SLOs. These results guide joint design of VLA model architectures, hardware, and runtime policies.

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型将多模态观测转化为低层机器人动作。在机器人运行过程中，每个控制周期设有推理截止时间，超时会导致机器人基于过时观测执行动作，从而降低任务成功率。为满足该截止时间要求，通常采用设备端或近端边缘执行方案，此时单台机器人需要在批大小为1的推理场景下运行，这超出了大语言模型（LLM）服务系统的设计范围。尽管VLA架构融合了熟悉的视觉-语言、自回归及扩散式组件，但其在批大小为1的控制场景下的运行时行为尚未被充分表征。本研究在边缘GPU服务器和两块机载系统级芯片（SoC）上，通过单次推理剖析及43,200次闭环试验，对四种代表性VLA模型进行了表征。动作张量的维度决定了某一阶段是受内存约束还是受计算约束，平台平衡性可能改变该瓶颈，而GPU频率调节会产生依赖平台的能耗-时延最优区间。在闭环运行中，推理与动作执行的重叠会产生精度-速度-能耗之间的权衡，且没有任何配置在部署服务水平目标（SLO）下具有帕累托优势。上述结果可为VLA模型架构、硬件及运行时策略的协同设计提供指导。

Authors: Seonghun Jung, Sieun Moon, Jiyoung Jeong, Jimin Lee, Jaehyuk Huh

FreeLoc: Online Floorplan Localization via Diffusion-Aided Pose Refinement Other

online floorplan localization diffusion-aided pose refinement geometric ray querying histogram-filter temporal fusion indoor robotic localization

简要说明：FreeLoc 提出了一种基于RGB的在线楼层平面图定位框架，将楼层平面图视为可直接查询的几何地图，通过高效的几何查询和扩散辅助位姿细化，在无离线数据库的情况下实现实时且最先进的单帧和序列定位性能。

TLDR: FreeLoc introduces an online RGB-based floorplan localization framework that treats floorplans as directly queryable geometric maps, using efficient geometric querying and diffusion-aided pose refinement to achieve real-time, state-of-the-art performance in both single-frame and sequential indoor localization without offline databases.

Abstract: Floorplans provide compact and widely available geometric maps for indoor localization, but existing high-performing floorplan-based methods still convert them into dense scene-specific offline databases, tying accuracy, storage, and runtime to the sampling resolution of the discretized pose space. We present FreeLoc, an online RGB-based floorplan localization framework that treats the floorplan as a directly queryable geometric map. FreeLoc introduces an efficient online geometric querying and diffusion-aided refinement scheme, which retrieves plausible pose anchors through on-the-fly floorplan ray querying and refines them into accurate continuous pose estimates. For sequential localization, FreeLoc develops an online likelihood construction strategy that bridges single-frame localization and probabilistic temporal fusion by constructing likelihoods from coarse-sampled candidates and refined pose hypotheses, enabling histogram-filter-based temporal fusion without offline databases. Experiments demonstrate real-time online inference and state-of-the-art performance in both single-frame and sequential localization, while real-world results validate practical deployability in indoor robotic localization scenarios.

摘要（中文）：平面图提供了一种紧凑且广泛可用的室内定位几何地图，但现有的高性能基于平面图的方法仍将其转换为密集的场景特定离线数据库，使得精度、存储和运行时与离散化位姿空间的采样分辨率挂钩。我们提出FreeLoc，一种基于RGB图像的在线平面图定位框架，将平面图视为可直接查询的几何地图。FreeLoc引入了一种高效的在线几何查询与扩散辅助细化方案，通过实时平面图射线查询检索合理的位姿锚点，并将其细化为精确的连续位姿估计。对于顺序定位，FreeLoc开发了一种在线似然构建策略，通过从粗采样候选和细化位姿假设构建似然，将单帧定位与概率时间融合衔接起来，实现无需离线数据库的直方图滤波时间融合。实验证明，该方法在单帧和顺序定位中均实现了实时在线推理和最先进的性能，同时真实场景结果验证了其在室内机器人定位场景中的实际可部署性。

Authors: Haocheng Peng, Boyang Zhou, Jiarui Hu, Xiyue Guo, Ziyang Zhang, Boming Zhao, Yifan Gao, Xiao Li, Hujun Bao, Zhaopeng Cui

A Unified Dynamics Framework for Reinforcement Learning and Classical Control of a Six-DOF Pipeline-Tracking ROV in NVIDIA Isaac Sim RLRobot

underwater ROV reinforcement learning sim-to-real Isaac Sim classical control

简要说明：本文提出了一个统一的动力学框架，用于在 NVIDIA Isaac Sim 中训练和部署六自由度水下遥控潜水器的强化学习与经典控制器，通过统一的 USD 场景和一致的物理参数提高仿真到现实的一致性，并比较了学习策略与经典控制策略。

TLDR: This paper introduces a unified dynamics framework for training and deploying reinforcement learning and classical controllers for a six-DOF underwater ROV in NVIDIA Isaac Sim, using a single USD scene with consistent physics parameters to improve sim-to-real consistency and compare learned and classical policies.

Abstract: Reinforcement learning controllers for underwater vehicles are usually trained against one physics representation and deployed against another, so reported performance does not always describe behavior outside training. This paper presents a pipeline-tracking architecture for a six-degree-of-freedom remotely operated vehicle (ROV) in which one Universal Scene Description (USD) scene supplies the real BlueROV2-Heavy mass, added-mass, damping, buoyancy, and thruster parameters to both halves of the system: a vectorized NumPy implementation of Fossen's marine-craft equations, and an interactive NVIDIA Isaac Sim deployment applying the identical equations as PhysX forces at every step. The Coriolis-centripetal term is the primary dynamics model in both branches; a controlled ablation on PPO and TRPO shows that including it does not destabilize either algorithm and modestly improves tracking, about 19 percent lower standoff RMS error for TRPO. Five reinforcement learning algorithms, PPO, soft actor-critic, TD3, DDPG, and TRPO, are trained against one environment, reward, and randomized evaluation harness through a checkpoint-compatibility layer scoring any policy with the same code. The pipeline is extended with six classical baselines, PID, sliding-mode, fuzzy logic, feedback linearization, model predictive control, and an adaptive neuro-fuzzy inference system, driven by the same guidance geometry and thruster allocation as the learned policies. Under Coriolis-enabled dynamics, PPO, TRPO, and feedback linearization reach the strongest combination of 100 percent success and competitive accuracy; PID, fuzzy control, and the neuro-fuzzy baseline also reach 100 percent success with looser tracking; DDPG and TD3 each show a specific, explainable failure mode rather than a general weakness of off-policy learning; and classical control remains a strong baseline against the best learned policies.

摘要（中文）：强化学习控制器在水下机器人领域的应用通常是在一种物理表示下训练，却在另一种物理表示下部署，因此所报告的性能并不能总是反映训练之外的行为。本文提出了一种针对六自由度遥控潜水器（ROV）的管道跟踪架构，其中单一通用场景描述（USD）场景为系统的两半部分提供真实的BlueROV2-Heavy质量、附加质量、阻尼、浮力和推进器参数：一部分是Fossen船舶运动方程的向量化NumPy实现，另一部分是交互式NVIDIA Isaac Sim部署，该部署在每一步都将相同的方程作为PhysX力应用。科里奥利-向心项是两个分支中的主要动力学模型；对PPO和TRPO进行的有控消融实验表明，包含该项不会使任一算法失稳，并且适度改善了跟踪效果，TRPO的稳态误差均方根降低了约19%。五种强化学习算法——PPO、软演员-评论家（SAC）、TD3、DDPG和TRPO——在相同的环境、奖励和随机化评估框架下进行训练，通过检查点兼容层实现用相同代码对任意策略进行评分。该管道扩展了六个经典基线方法：PID、滑模控制、模糊逻辑、反馈线性化、模型预测控制以及自适应神经模糊推理系统，这些方法由与学习策略相同的制导几何和推进器分配驱动。在启用科里奥利效应的动力学条件下，PPO、TRPO和反馈线性化达到了100%成功率和竞争性精度的最强组合；PID、模糊控制和神经模糊基线也达到了100%成功率，但跟踪精度较宽松；DDPG和TD3各自表现出一种特定的、可解释的失败模式，而非离策略学习的普遍弱点；经典控制方法在面对最优学习策略时仍是强有力的基线。

Authors: Cheng Siong Chin, M. Venkateshkumar, Jianhua Zhang

RobotUse: Allocating Computation, Context, and Decisions Manipulation

robot agent harness visual goal selection subagents persistent playbook motion planning

简要说明：RobotUse 提出了一种机器人代理框架，将视觉目标选择与后端运动规划分离，通过子代理和持久剧本提高任务成功率，并支持从真实世界执行中学习。

TLDR: RobotUse introduces a robot agent harness that separates visual goal selection from backend motion planning, using subagents and a persistent playbook to improve task success and enable learning from real-world execution.

Abstract: Robot agents must connect their intended actions to observed outcomes while retaining the context needed to revise their choices over repeated attempts. Existing interfaces often leave these choices inside predefined tools or require agents to manage detailed execution code and its growing history. We introduce RobotUse, a robot agent harness that organizes computation, context, and decisions around specifying and revising physical actions. Agents visually select targets and poses, while the backend handles geometry, motion planning, and control. Subagents retain detailed interactions within each subgoal and return the information needed for subsequent decisions. Continual harnessing lets agents learn from execution by updating a persistent playbook. On RoboLab, RobotUse achieves 45% task success, outperforming CaP-X by 6.7 percentage points while maintaining compact decision contexts and reducing reliance on predefined action abstractions. Furthermore, we show that RobotUse learns from real-world execution despite imperfect feedback and transfers what it learns to subsequent tasks. Project page is available at https://robotuse-team.github.io/.

摘要（中文）：机器人智能体必须将预期行为与实际观测结果相连接，同时保留在多次尝试中修正选择所需的上下文信息。现有接口往往将这些选择局限于预定义的工具中，或要求智能体管理详细的执行代码及其不断增长的历史记录。我们提出了RobotUse——一个围绕物理行为的指定与修正来组织计算、上下文和决策的机器人智能体框架。智能体通过视觉方式选择目标和位姿，而后端负责处理几何、运动规划和控制。子智能体在每个子目标内保留详细的交互信息，并返回后续决策所需的信息。持续框架化使智能体能够通过更新持久化操作手册来从执行过程中学习。在RoboLab上，RobotUse达到了45%的任务成功率，比CaP-X高出6.7个百分点，同时保持了紧凑的决策上下文，并减少了对预定义行为抽象的依赖。此外，我们证明RobotUse即使在反馈不完美的情况下也能从真实世界执行中学习，并将其所学迁移到后续任务中。项目页面可在https://robotuse-team.github.io/获取。

Authors: Junhoo Lee, Injun Baek, Seungyeon Kim, Suhyun Jeon, Minkyu Kim, Baekseung Kim, Nojun Kwak

Distributed Cascade Force Control of Soft-Tactile-Based Multi-robot System for Object Transportation Other

distributed cascade force control soft tactile sensors multi-robot object pushing Lyapunov stability real-world validation

简要说明：本文提出了一种分布式级联力控制系统（DCFC），使配备软触觉传感器的多移动机器人在无需相互通信的情况下，协同推动物体朝向移动目标。

TLDR: This paper proposes a distributed cascade force control (DCFC) system for multiple mobile robots equipped with soft tactile sensors to collaboratively push an object toward a moving target without inter-robot communication.

Abstract: In this paper, we present a distributed cascade force control system (DCFC) for multiple robots with the aim of pushing a rigid object towards a desired moving target without their inter-robot communication. These mobile robots are equipped with 360-degree vision-based soft tactile sensors utilized to determine contact location and resultant impact force. By investigating the dynamics of moving rigid objects on the flat, we proposed a distributed cascade control. The inner loop control incorporates contact force and positioning, ensuring the robots' pushing contact and application of the desired force to the object. The outer loop control coordinates the robots to push the object in a desired direction without inter-robot communication, regardless of the unknown object mass. The stability and convergence of the system are verified using the Lyapunov stability theory. We also conducted simulation and real-word experiments to validate the performance of the proposed control method, and the experimental results showcase the successful coordination of multiple robots in pushing an object towards a moving desired direction.

摘要（中文）：本文提出了一种分布式级联力控制系统（DCFC），用于多机器人协同推动刚性物体朝目标方向移动，且无需机器人之间的相互通信。这些移动机器人配备了基于360度视觉的软触觉传感器，用于确定接触位置及合成冲击力。通过研究平面上移动刚性物体的动力学特性，我们设计了一种分布式级联控制器。内环控制融合了接触力与定位，确保机器人保持推动接触并对物体施加期望力。外环控制则协调各机器人在未知物体质量的情况下，无需彼此通信即可朝期望方向推动物体。我们利用李雅普诺夫稳定性理论验证了系统的稳定性与收敛性，并进行了仿真与实物实验以评估所提控制方法的性能。实验结果表明，多机器人能够成功协同将物体推向动态期望方向。
