Authors: Duy Anh Nguyen, Nhat Minh Dinh Le, Nhan Huu Nguyen, Pham Duy Hung, Van Anh Ho, Trung Dung Ngo

Flow Policies as Actions of Skill-Level World Models: Learned and Symbolic Abstractions for Long-Horizon Planning WorldModel

flow-matching policy latent world models skill-level actions long-horizon planning block rearrangement

简要说明：该论文提出将流匹配策略作为技能级动作空间用于潜世界模型，通过将底层控制抽象为学习或符号化的技能转换，实现机器人操作中的长时程规划。

TLDR: This paper proposes using a flow-matching policy as a skill-level action space for latent world models, enabling long-horizon planning in robotic manipulation by abstracting low-level controls into learned or symbolic skill transitions.

Abstract: Latent world models enable robots to plan by predicting the consequences of actions. Planning long tasks with control-rate actions requires many prediction steps, which enlarges the search space and accumulates error. Skill-level actions shorten these sequences, but a symbolic skill vocabulary requires domain knowledge and labeled demonstrations. We construct skill-level actions from the inputs of a flow-matching policy trained on demonstrations segmented into complete skills. The policy maps a noise seed and an observation, optionally with a code or label, to a complete skill execution, so one execution is one world-model transition. On this mechanism we propose four action abstractions with increasing task knowledge: a compressed seed, two discrete codes learned from the demonstrations, and a symbolic label. We evaluate them with a common world-model training procedure and planning framework on simulated block rearrangement tasks that require up to 14 sequential skills. The symbolic label succeeds in over 90% of the tasks that require up to six skills and degrades beyond. Without any label, an object-centric learned code matches it on single-skill tasks and retains half to three quarters of its success on tasks of two to five skills. Ablations attribute much of the label's advantage to its planner knowing which actions are applicable, rather than to the label itself. Beyond six skills the search, not the world model, limits success. Project page: https://andreumatoses.github.io/research/flow-skill-wm

摘要（中文）：潜在世界模型使机器人能够通过预测动作的后果来进行规划。以控制频率动作规划长周期任务需要大量预测步骤，这会扩大搜索空间并累积误差。技能级动作可缩短这些序列，但符号化的技能词汇表需要领域知识和带标注的演示数据。我们从分段为完整技能的演示数据中训练流匹配策略，并基于其输入构建技能级动作。该策略将噪声种子和观测（可选地附带代码或标签）映射为完整的技能执行过程，因此一次执行即对应一次世界模型状态转移。在此机制基础上，我们提出了四种动作抽象方式，其任务知识量递增：压缩种子、从演示中学习到的两种离散代码以及符号标签。我们在需要多达14个连续技能的模拟积木重排任务中，使用统一的世界模型训练流程和规划框架对其进行了评估。符号标签在最多需要六个技能的任务中成功率超过90%，超过该范围后性能下降。在无需任何标签的情况下，一种以对象为中心的习得代码在单技能任务中与符号标签表现相当，并在两至五个技能的任务中保持其成功率的二分之一至四分之三。消融实验表明，标签的优势主要归因于规划器能够知晓哪些动作适用，而非标签本身。当技能数超过六个时，限制成功率的因素是搜索而非世界模型。项目页面：https://andreumatoses.github.io/research/flow-skill-wm

Authors: Andreu Matoses Gimenez, Andrei-Carlo Papuc, Chris Pek, Javier Alonso-Mora

How corner is a corner case? Percentile control for highway scenario generation AutonomousDriving

corner-case scenario generation risk percentile control diffusion model autonomous driving simulation post-encroachment time

简要说明：本文提出了一种生成具有可控“极端度”的驾驶边角场景的方法，通过学习一个基于百分位条件的扩散模型，将期望的风险百分位映射到物理驾驶目标，从而实现对场景逆境性的校准生成和评估。

TLDR: This paper introduces a method for generating corner-case driving scenarios with controlled 'cornerness' by learning a percentile-conditioned diffusion model that maps desired risk percentiles to physical driving targets, enabling calibrated generation and evaluation of scenario adversity.

Abstract: Generating corner-case scenarios with appropriate adversity in a simulation environment is critical for testing an autonomous vehicle (AV) software stack's safety performance before deployment. Existing autonomous-driving scenario generators can enforce specific behavior, adversity, or feasibility conditions, but they provide limited control over how extreme a generated scenario is relative to plausible futures in the same traffic context. This study represents the adversity of a generated scenario as its percentile in the conditional distribution of future risk given the observed history. This view supports calibrated answers to two questions: how "corner" a generated corner-case scenario is and how its "cornerness" can be fine-tuned. To this end, we formulate history-conditioned risk-percentile requests and learn a reference risk distribution that maps each requested percentile to a physical risk target. We then use a percentile-conditioned joint diffusion model with sampling-time risk guidance to generate multi-agent futures, together with a reference-based criterion for evaluating percentile realization. Experiments use the minimum post-encroachment time (PET) between the ego and its surrounding vehicles as the risk surrogate on highD. On the primary evaluation set, our method realizes 1,422 of 1,440 requests within a 0.05 percentile tolerance (98.75%), with mean percentile error 0.00673 and PET-target error 0.00991 seconds. The resulting interface connects context-relative risk specification, physical realization, and evaluation through a common risk scale. Project website and videos of generated scenarios are available at https://hhj233.github.io/CornerPercentile/.

摘要（中文）：生成具有适当危险性的边界场景对于在部署前测试自动驾驶汽车软件栈的安全性能至关重要。现有的自动驾驶场景生成器可以强制执行特定行为、危险性或可行性条件，但它们对生成场景相对于同一交通情境中合理未来事件而言的极端程度控制有限。本研究将生成场景的危险性表示为其在给定观测历史条件下未来风险条件分布中的百分位数。这一视角支持对两个问题进行校准回答：生成的边界场景有多“边界”，以及如何微调其“边界程度”。 为此，我们提出了基于历史条件的风险百分位数请求，并学习一个参考风险分布，将每个请求的百分位数映射到物理风险目标。随后，我们使用带有采样时风险引导的百分位数条件联合扩散模型生成多智能体未来轨迹，并采用基于参考的标准来评估百分位数的实现情况。 实验以自车与其周围车辆之间的最小后侵入时间（PET）作为风险替代指标，在highD数据集上进行。在主要评估集上，我们的方法在0.05百分位数容差内实现了1,422/1,440个请求（98.75%），平均百分位数误差为0.00673，PET目标误差为0.00991秒。所得到的接口通过统一的风险尺度将情境相对风险规范、物理实现和评估连接起来。项目网站及生成场景的视频见 https://hhj233.github.io/CornerPercentile/。

Authors: Jiaxi Liu, Hang Zhou, Hangyu Li, Yifan Wang, Keke Long, Chengyuan Ma, Bin Ran, Xiaopeng Li

EMBER-Bench: Benchmarking Cross-Event Causal Memory in Long-Horizon Embodied Tasks Other

causal reasoning embodied benchmarks long-horizon tasks egocentric video next-action prediction

简要说明：EMBER-Bench 是一个新的以自我为中心的基准，用于评估长视界具身任务中的跨事件因果记忆与推理，包含 189 个家庭任务和 699 个 QA 对。对 16 个模型的评估显示与人类表现存在显著差距，突出了从过去事件中提取因果信息以约束当前动作的困难。

TLDR: EMBER-Bench is a new egocentric benchmark for evaluating cross-event causal memory and reasoning in long-horizon embodied tasks, with 189 household tasks and 699 QA pairs. Evaluations on 16 models show significant gaps versus human performance, highlighting the difficulty of extracting causal information from past events to constrain current actions.

Abstract: Lifelong physical agents must reason over extended interactions where past events continue to shape the world long after they disappear from view. Beyond recalling what happened, agents must infer how history changes the current state and constrains future actions. Yet existing embodied and video-memory benchmarks largely focus on historical retrieval and summary, leaving such history-dependent causal reasoning underexplored. We introduce EMBER-Bench, an egocentric benchmark for cross-event causal reasoning in long-horizon embodied tasks, for which we newly created the task design, video recording, and data annotation. It contains 189 household tasks and 699 QA pairs, spanning task progress, failure recovery, external interventions, and compound long-horizon tasks with distant dependencies and prerequisites, with fine-grained event and causal-chain annotations. EMBER-Bench evaluates reasoning in both directions: next-action prediction selects the next action from history, and causal traceback, given that action, identifies the historical event that makes it necessary. Input ablations that add action logs or privileged cause-and-consequence annotations to the video indicate which kind of historical information models fail to use. Among the 16 evaluated models, the highest overall accuracy is 61.2%, compared with a mean of 98.3% across two human evaluators. At paired decision points, correct traceback is not associated with correct next-action prediction. Adding action logs yields a gain of 1.6 points, whereas cause-and-consequence annotations yield an additional gain of 13.0 points on top of that. These results suggest that extracting causal information from past events and converting it into constraints on current actions remains a key difficulty for long-horizon embodied agents. Project Page: https://zhaoalexgoat.github.io/EMBER-Bench/

摘要（中文）：终身物理智能体必须在长期交互中进行推理，在此过程中，过去的事件即使从视野中消失，也会持续塑造世界状态。除了回忆已发生的事情，智能体还必须推断历史如何改变当前状态并约束未来行动。然而，现有的具身与视频记忆基准主要聚焦于历史检索和摘要，导致此类依赖历史事件的因果推理尚未得到充分探索。我们提出EMBER-Bench，一个用于长周期具身任务中跨事件因果推理的自我中心基准，并为此全新设计了任务、视频录制及数据标注。该基准包含189个家务任务和699个问答对，覆盖任务进展、失败恢复、外部干预，以及具有跨距离依赖和前置条件的复合长周期任务，并附有细粒度的事件与因果链标注。EMBER-Bench从两个方向评估推理能力：下一动作预测根据历史选择下一动作，而因果回溯则针对给定动作，识别使其成为必要的历史事件。通过向视频输入中添加动作日志或特权因果注释的消融实验，可揭示模型未能利用哪类历史信息。在评估的16个模型中，最高总体准确率为61.2%，而两位人工评估者的平均准确率为98.3%。在成对决策点上，正确的因果回溯与正确的下一动作预测并不相关。添加动作日志带来1.6个百分点的提升，而在此之上因果注释进一步带来13.0个百分点的提升。上述结果表明，从过去事件中提取因果信息并将其转化为对当前行动的约束，仍是长周期具身智能体的关键难点。项目页面：https://zhaoalexgoat.github.io/EMBER-Bench/

Authors: Aoyang Cai, Boning Zhao, Shaoxuan Xie, Dahui Gao, Huan Yang, Zhongyuan Wang, Zhiwei Yu, Guocai Yao

Reflection-Robust 6DoF Object Tracking with Light Fields Perception3D

6DoF object tracking light fields reflection-robust pose estimation RGB-D

简要说明：本文提出了一种基于光场的6DoF物体跟踪方法，通过将视角相关外观分解为漫反射反照率和环境贴图，实现对反射表面的鲁棒跟踪，并在机器人操作基准和真实光场序列上验证了其有效性。

TLDR: This paper introduces a light field based 6DoF object tracking method that is robust to reflective surfaces by decomposing view-dependent appearance into diffuse albedo and environment map, and demonstrates effectiveness on a re-rendered robotic manipulation benchmark and captured light field sequences.

Abstract: Tracking the 6DoF pose of a moving rigid object is fundamental to robotics and autonomous driving, but existing trackers assume that object appearance is stable across a sequence, an assumption that breaks down on reflective surfaces whose appearance changes as they mirror the environment. We introduce a light field based reflection-robust 6DoF tracker that turns this apparent nuisance into a pose cue. Per frame, our method recovers depth robustly against reflections, back-projects it into a point cloud, and estimates surface normals. It then decomposes the object's view-dependent appearance into a diffuse albedo and the environment map it reflects, resulting in a relightable surface light field. Starting from a coarse initialization, we relight it by the recovered environment map and optimize the pose on the photometric loss. Because a moving object mirrors new parts of the scene, the environment map fills in as the sequence proceeds, sharpening this signal over time. To evaluate this approach, we introduce a light field tracking dataset re-rendered from a robotic manipulation benchmark at four controlled reflectivity levels, each paired with simulated depth that reproduces how consumer RGB-D sensors fail on shiny surfaces. Additionally, we evaluate on two captured light field sequences. Our method trails the strongest baselines on diffuse objects and is the only one that holds its accuracy on fully reflective objects, where every baseline degrades.

摘要（中文）：追踪运动刚体物体的6DoF姿态是机器人和自动驾驶领域的基础问题，但现有的追踪器假设物体外观在序列中保持稳定，这一假设在反射表面上不成立，因为反射表面的外观会随其映照的环境而变化。我们提出了一种基于光场的抗反射6DoF追踪器，将这一看似不利的因素转化为姿态线索。我们的方法在每一帧中，针对反射情况稳健地恢复深度，将其反投影为点云，并估计表面法线。随后，它将物体随视角变化的外观分解为漫反射反照率及其反射的环境贴图，从而生成一个可重新照明的表面光场。从粗略初始化开始，我们利用恢复的环境贴图对其进行重新照明，并基于光度损失优化姿态。由于运动物体会镜像场景中的新区域，环境贴图会随着序列的推进而逐步充盈，从而随时间增强这一信号。为评估该方法，我们引入了一个光场追踪数据集，该数据集从机器人操作基准中重新渲染，包含四个受控反射率级别，每个级别都配有模拟深度，再现了消费级RGB-D传感器在光泽表面上的失效模式。此外，我们还在两个采集的光场序列上进行了评估。我们的方法在漫反射物体上略逊于最强基线，但在全反射物体上是唯一保持精度的，而所有基线在全反射物体上均出现性能下降。

Authors: Nikolai Goncharov, Donald G. Dansereau

How Long, Not How Close: A Learned Temporal Metric for Planning in Latent World Models WorldModel

latent world models temporal-distance planning model-based reinforcement learning LeWM PLDM

简要说明：TEMPO 从演示中学习时间距离度量，改进冻结潜世界模型中的规划，通过环境步骤而不是潜在相似度衡量目标接近度。

TLDR: TEMPO learns a temporal-distance metric from demonstrations that improves planning in frozen latent world models by measuring goal proximity in environment steps, not latent similarity.

Abstract: Latent world models plan by rolling a frozen predictor forward under candidate action sequences and ranking the candidates by the latent distance between their imagined end state and the goal. However, this ranking breaks down when the goal lies several plans away, because the latent distance measures how closely an end state resembles the goal rather than how far it remains from reaching it. To address this, we propose TEMPO, a temporal-distance planning objective that leaves the world model untouched, learns only from the demonstrations already used to train it, and adds negligible cost to the planner's search. TEMPO learns a small map of the frozen latent in which the distance between two states of an episode reflects the number of environment steps between them, and blends this distance into the planner's cost. It requires no rewards, policies or success labels and, being a cost rather than a model, applies to frozen world models with one latent vector per state that plan by a latent distance. We evaluate TEMPO on eleven simulated environments (e.g., maze navigation, tabletop pushing, robotic arm control and three-dimensional manipulation) with the LeWM and PLDM planners. With a small MLP that adds at most 0.3% to a plan's arithmetic, TEMPO improves both planners at every goal distance, including the one-plan setting of their evaluations, raises LeWM from 36% to 99% on TwoRoom three plans from the goal, and remains competitive on a broad range of 2D and 3D navigation, reaching and manipulation tasks.

摘要（中文）：潜在世界模型通过将冻结的预测器在候选动作序列下向前滚动，并依据想象终点状态与目标之间的潜在距离对候选序列进行排序来制定规划。然而，当目标距离多个规划周期时，这种排序会失效，因为潜在距离衡量的是终点状态与目标的相似程度，而非距离达成目标还差多远。为解决这一问题，我们提出TEMPO，一种时间距离规划目标，它不改变世界模型，仅利用训练该模型所使用过的演示数据进行学习，并且为规划器的搜索增加可忽略不计的代价。TEMPO在冻结的潜在空间中学习一个小型映射，其中一段情节中两个状态之间的距离反映它们之间环境步数的间隔，并将该距离融入规划器的代价中。它不需要奖励、策略或成功标签，且因为这是一种代价而非模型，因此适用于每个状态对应一个潜在向量并通过潜在距离进行规划的冻结世界模型。我们在十一个模拟环境（如迷宫导航、桌面推物、机械臂控制和三维操作）中，结合LeWM和PLDM规划器对TEMPO进行了评估。凭借一个最多为规划算术增加0.3%计算量的小型MLP，TEMPO在每个目标距离上都提升了两种规划器的表现，包括其评估中的单规划周期设置，在TwoRoom场景中距目标三个规划周期时将LeWM的准确率从36%提升至99%，并在广泛的2D和3D导航、到达及操作任务中保持竞争力。

Authors: Lama Moukheiber, Haotian Xue, Yongxin Chen

PB-STDG: A Prediction-Based Short-Term Decentralized Greedy Guidance Algorithm for a Drone Road System Other

drone traffic management decentralized guidance collision avoidance prediction mechanism urban airspace

简要说明：本文提出PB-STDG，一种基于预测的分布式贪心引导算法，用于无人机道路系统，通过让无人机预判邻居决策，在保持安全性的同时提高交通效率。

TLDR: This paper proposes PB-STDG, a prediction-based decentralized greedy guidance algorithm for drone road systems that improves traffic efficiency while maintaining safety by enabling drones to anticipate neighbors' decisions.

Abstract: In recent years, Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) or drones have been increasingly adopted in urban environments for applications such as parcel delivery, infrastructure inspection, emergency response, and drone light shows. A non-negligible issue is how to manage the increasing number of drones operated by different entities, to enable them to cooperatively avoid potential collisions and determine conflict-free short-term flight paths in urban airspace. This paper presents a Prediction-Based Short-Term Decentralized Greedy (PB-STDG) guidance algorithm for a structured Drone Road System (DRS). PB-STDG extends the original STDG algorithm by introducing a prediction mechanism that enables drones to anticipate the decisions of neighboring drones using additional information shared in beacon packets, aiming to address the over-conservative behavior observed in the STDG algorithm. Several simulation scenarios are conducted to evaluate and compare the proposed algorithm with STDG. The results show that PB-STDG improves traffic efficiency while maintaining a safety level comparable to that of STDG.

摘要（中文）：近年来，无人机在城市环境中的应用日益广泛，涉及包裹配送、基础设施检查、应急响应及无人机灯光秀等领域。一个不容忽视的问题是如何管理由不同实体运营的日益增多的无人机，使其能够在城市空域中协同避碰，并确定无冲突的短期飞行路径。本文提出了一种基于预测的短期分散贪婪（PB-STDG）引导算法，用于结构化的无人机道路系统（DRS）。PB-STDG在原有STDG算法的基础上引入预测机制，使无人机能利用信标数据包中共享的附加信息预判邻域无人机的决策，旨在解决STDG算法中观察到的过度保守行为。通过多个仿真场景对所提算法与STDG进行对比评估，结果表明，PB-STDG在保持与STDG相当的安全水平的同时，有效提升了交通效率。

Authors: Zhouyu Qu, Andreas Willig, Xiaobing Wu

Direction-Conditioned Policies for Online Goal-Conditioned Reinforcement Learning RLRobot

Contrastive RL goal-conditioned RL navigation manipulation waypoint

简要说明：本文提出方向条件策略（DCP），通过对表示空间中航路点的方向和距离进行条件化，改进对比强化学习，提升目标条件导航和操作任务的成功率。

TLDR: This paper proposes Direction-Conditioned Policies (DCP), a modification to Contrastive Reinforcement Learning that conditions policies on direction and distance to waypoints in representation space, improving goal-conditioned navigation and manipulation success rates.

Abstract: Contrastive Reinforcement Learning (CRL) learns representations that estimate goal reachability, yet its policy remains conditioned on raw goals and therefore does not directly exploit the geometry encoded by its critic. We introduce Direction-Conditioned Policies (DCP), a method built around a small modification to CRL: DCP selects previously visited states as waypoints during online training and conditions the policy on their direction and distance in representation space. At deployment, DCP applies the same interface directly to the final goal, requiring neither waypoint selection nor planning. Across nine navigation and manipulation tasks, DCP attains higher final success rates than CRL on seven tasks and spends more time near the goal on seven. Controlled maze experiments further show that DCP captures shortest-path geometry more accurately and that the supplied direction causally influences the actor's behavior. We identify waypoint coverage and ranking as limits to exploration, and show that learned candidate generation improves goal reaching in two controlled mazes.

摘要（中文）：对比强化学习（CRL）学习表征以估计目标可达性，但其策略仍以原始目标为条件，因此并未直接利用评判器所编码的几何结构。我们提出方向条件策略（DCP），一种基于对CRL进行微小修改的方法：DCP在在线训练期间选择先前访问过的状态作为路径点，并在表征空间中依据这些路径点的方向与距离来调节策略。在部署时，DCP直接对最终目标应用相同接口，既不需要路径点选择，也不需要规划。在九项导航与操作任务中，DCP在七项任务上取得了比CRL更高的最终成功率，并在七项任务中在目标附近花费了更多时间。受控迷宫实验进一步表明，DCP能更准确地捕捉最短路径几何结构，且所提供的方向对行动者的行为具有因果性影响。我们识别出路径点覆盖与排序是限制探索的因素，并表明在两组受控迷宫中，学习式候选生成能够改善目标到达能力。

Authors: S K Swaminathan, Damiya Gondha, Theyanesh Eswaramoorthy Rajahkrishnan, Aritra Hazra

GJK-CBF: Control Barrier Functions for Convex Rigid Body Collision Avoidance on SE(3) Other

Control Barrier Functions Collision Avoidance GJK Algorithm SE(3) Real-time Safety Filtering

简要说明：本文提出GJK-CBF，一种用于凸刚体碰撞避免的控制屏障函数，利用GJK算法的见证点直接构造梯度，避免了昂贵的可微优化。在2D和3D多机器人和机械臂场景中验证了其有效性，实现了无碰撞运动并降低了保守性。

TLDR: This paper introduces GJK-CBF, a control barrier function for collision avoidance among convex rigid bodies that leverages the Gilbert-Johnson-Keerthi (GJK) algorithm's witness points to construct gradients directly, avoiding computationally expensive differentiable optimization. The method is validated in 2D and 3D multi-robot and manipulator scenarios, demonstrating collision-free motion with reduced conservativeness.

Abstract: Collision avoidance among convex bodies is a fundamental problem in robotics. Control Barrier Functions (CBFs) provide a practical framework for real-time safety filtering due to their computational efficiency. For general convex bodies, exact separation measures, such as distance or scaling factor, are typically computed through optimization. Existing CBF formulations often obtain the required gradient via differentiable optimization (diffOpt), adding computational overhead. In contrast, we leverage the Gilbert-Johnson-Keerthi (GJK) algorithm to obtain the current witness pair---the pair of points realizing the minimum distance or penetration depth---and formulate a CBF, termed GJK-CBF, whose gradient is constructed directly from the relative rigid-body motion of the witness pair, without resorting to diffOpt. This formulation applies to both 2D and 3D environments across a broad class of convex body pairs, provided that at least one in each one-to-one interaction is strictly convex. The proposed GJK-CBF is validated in various scenarios, including multi-robot position swapping in both 2D and 3D, navigation through a vertical slit in 3D, and its applicability to manipulators. The results demonstrate collision-free motion across all scenarios while reducing the conservativeness introduced by geometric approximations, particularly in narrow environments.

摘要（中文）：凸体之间的碰撞避免是机器人学中的一个基本问题。控制障碍函数（CBFs）因其计算效率高，为实时安全滤波提供了一种实用的框架。对于一般凸体，精确的分离度量（如距离或缩放因子）通常通过优化计算获得。现有的CBF公式往往通过可微优化（diffOpt）获取所需梯度，这增加了计算开销。相比之下，我们利用Gilbert-Johnson-Keerthi（GJK）算法获取当前见证点对——即实现最小距离或穿透深度的点对——并构建一种称为GJK-CBF的CBF，其梯度直接从见证点对的相对刚体运动中构造，无需借助diffOpt。该公式适用于2D和3D环境中的广泛凸体对类别，前提是每个一对一交互中至少有一个物体是严格凸的。所提出的GJK-CBF在多种场景中得到验证，包括2D和3D中的多机器人位置交换、3D中通过垂直狭缝的导航，以及其在机械臂上的适用性。结果表明，在所有场景中均实现了无碰撞运动，同时减少了由几何近似引入的保守性，尤其是在狭窄环境中。

Authors: Yi-Hsuan Chen, Shuo Liu, Wei Xiao, Michael Otte, Calin Belta

Tackling Sim-to-Real Mismatch Through Sampling-Based Disturbance Observers: From Analytical Models to Learned World Models Other

disturbance observer sim-to-real learned world models robot control cost-query

简要说明：本文提出基于采样的扰动观测器（SDOB），通过状态回滚或成本查询接口补偿仿真到现实的失配，适用于传统模型与学习的世界模型，并在仿真和真实机器人上验证。

TLDR: This paper proposes sampling-based disturbance observers (SDOB) to compensate for sim-to-real mismatches in robotic control, extending the DOB principle to analytical models, simulators, and learned world models, with validation in simulation and real-robot experiments.

Abstract: Robotic controllers increasingly rely on analytical models, simulators, cost-query interfaces, and learned world models. However, physical deployment can deviate from nominal assumptions, and additional disturbances may arise even when the model itself is accurate. In control systems, disturbance observers (DOB) are widely used to estimate such unmeasured effects from nominal models and measured feedback. Classical DOB formulations are generally built around explicit plant models. This paper develops the sampling-based disturbance observer (SDOB), extending the DOB principle to a broader range of models, including simulators and learned world models, through state-rollout or cost-query interfaces. SDOB separates two observable channels: state-effect disturbances, for which the feedback state differs from its prediction, and cost disturbances, for which the same query state receives different costs as the perceived environment changes. Diverse simulation and real-robot experiments across traditional and learned models demonstrate the effectiveness of SDOB in compensating for sim-to-real mismatch and improving control performance.

摘要（中文）：摘要：机器人控制器日益依赖于解析模型、模拟器、成本查询接口以及学习型世界模型。然而，实际部署中可能会偏离名义假设，即使模型本身准确，也可能出现额外的扰动。在控制系统中，扰动观测器（DOB）被广泛用于从名义模型和测量反馈中估计此类未测量的影响。经典的DOB公式通常基于显式的被控对象模型构建。本文开发了基于采样的扰动观测器（SDOB），将DOB原理扩展到更广泛的模型类型，包括模拟器和学习型世界模型，通过状态展开或成本查询接口实现。SDOB分离了两个可观测通道：状态效应扰动——反馈状态与预测不一致的情况，以及成本扰动——同一查询状态因感知环境变化而接收不同成本的情况。在传统模型和学习模型上的多样化仿真及真实机器人实验表明，SDOB在补偿仿真到现实的不匹配及提高控制性能方面具有有效性。

Authors: Tianqi Zhu, Jun Yang, Jianliang Mao, Cong Li, Shihua Li

Lie Rarely, Lie Big: Stealthy Insider Attacks on LLM Robot Teams Other

LLM robot teams stealthy adversary multi-robot survey verification budget map error

简要说明：本文分析了LLM协调的多机器人团队中的隐蔽内部攻击，推导了攻击检测概率和地图误差的理论界，并通过LLM智能体实验验证。

TLDR: This paper analyzes stealthy insider attacks in LLM-coordinated multi-robot teams, deriving theoretical bounds on attack detection probability and map error, validated with LLM-agent experiments.

Abstract: When a team of robots delegates planning and mutual trust to LLM agents, a single compromised robot can corrupt the shared outcome. We study this threat in a grounded task: a multi-robot survey in which measurements can be verified against the physical world, but every verification costs budget that would otherwise advance the mission. We treat the compromised robot as a stealthy adversary in the system-theoretic sense: it is limited not by an energy bound but by the team's own detectors. We then derive two bounds. First, the probability that the adversary's reports are verified is bounded below in terms of the degrees in the communication graph and the verification budget. Second, the map error caused by any stealthy adversary is bounded above by the value of a linear program over the adversary's bias distributions; its solution is an exchange rate between stealth budget and damage: below a critical verification level the worst stealthy attack tells rare, full-magnitude lies on the records least likely to be verified, and above it the better purchase is small biases hidden in the noise. In experiments where the honest robots are LLM agents, both bounds hold at the budget the attack actually spent. The experiments also show that which records an LLM robot re-checks is unbiased, but how much it re-checks is unpredictable.

摘要（中文）：当一组机器人将规划与相互信任委托给大语言模型（LLM）智能体时，单个被入侵的机器人便可能污染共享的协作成果。我们在一项具有物理依据的任务中研究这一威胁：一项多机器人勘测任务，其中测量结果可对照物理世界进行验证，但每次验证都会消耗本可推进任务进程的预算。我们将被入侵的机器人视为系统论意义上的隐蔽对手：其限制并非来自能量边界，而是来自团队自身的检测机制。随后我们推导出两个界限。第一，对手报告被验证的概率，其下界由通信图中的节点度数及验证预算决定。第二，由任意隐蔽对手造成的地图误差，其上界由关于对手偏差分布的线性规划的值给出；该规划的解即为隐蔽预算与破坏程度之间的交换比率：在临界验证水平之下，最恶劣的隐蔽攻击会在最不可能被验证的记录上散布罕见但全量级的谎言；而高于该水平时，更有效的购买策略是将微小偏差隐藏在噪声之中。在诚实机器人为LLM智能体的实验中，两个界限在实际攻击所花费的预算下均成立。实验还表明，LLM机器人重新检查哪些记录是无偏的，但其重新检查的频次则不可预测。

Authors: Sribalaji C. Anand, George J. Pappas

BeliefGraph-JEPA: Structured Latent World Models for Action-Conditioned Time Series WorldModel

structured latent world model action-conditioned forecasting joint-embedding predictive architecture graph routing latent effect states

简要说明：BeliefGraph-JEPA 提出了一种结构化潜在世界模型，用于动作条件下的时间序列预测，将驱动影响分解为类型化潜在效应状态，并通过图进行路由，在临床、农业、环境和工业数据集上优于基线。

TLDR: BeliefGraph-JEPA introduces a structured latent world model with action-conditioned time-series forecasting, factoring driver influence into typed latent-effect states that evolve and route through a graph, outperforming baselines on clinical, agricultural, environmental, and industrial datasets.

Abstract: Action-conditioned time-series forecasting requires accounting for how future actions and exogenous forcings influence multiple targets through partially observed effects with different delays and persistence. Direct conditioning leaves the evolution and target-specific influence of these effects implicit in the predictor, while static relational graphs specify connections without tracking evolving effects. This motivates representing future-driver influence through structured latent states that evolve over the forecast horizon and route information to individual targets. We introduce BeliefGraph-JEPA, a structured latent world model that factorizes driver influence into typed latent-effect states. These states are rolled forward under future drivers and routed through a graph to target-specific nodes, forming the predictive base of a joint-embedding predictive architecture. A capacity-controlled residual supplements this base with direct driver information. On four multi-target clinical, agricultural, environmental, and industrial systems, the framework outperforms a range of pretrained and supervised known-future-covariate baselines. Matched controls isolate latent dynamics, future rollout, graph routing, and residual capacity; future rollout and graph-first residual routing improve forecasting across all four systems.

摘要（中文）：基于动作的条件时间序列预测要求考虑未来动作和外部强迫如何通过部分观测到的、具有不同延迟和持续性的效应来影响多个目标。直接条件化将这些效应的演变及目标特定影响隐含在预测器中，而静态关系图则在不追踪演变效应的情况下指定连接关系。这促使通过结构化的潜在状态来表示未来驱动因素的影响，这些状态在预测范围内演变并将信息路由至各个目标。我们提出了BeliefGraph-JEPA，一种结构化潜在世界模型，将驱动因素影响分解为类型化的潜在效应状态。这些状态在未来驱动因素下向前滚动，并通过图路由至目标特定节点，构成联合嵌入预测架构的预测基础。容量受控的残差以直接驱动因素信息补充该基础。在四个多目标临床、农业、环境和工业系统中，该框架优于一系列预训练和监督式已知未来协变量基线。匹配对照隔离了潜在动态、未来滚动、图路由和残差容量；未来滚动和图优先残差路由在所有四个系统中均改善了预测性能。
